title: Village Dissolution in New York State: Lessons in Self-Governance
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Village Dissolution in New York State: Lessons in Self-Governance

publicationDetails.detailsText: Center for Governance and Markets Paper No. No. GDD13-2025
publicationDetails.journalName: Center for Governance & Markets Paper Series

detail.abstract: The recent conference on Self-Governance and Pluralism in Divided Times invited scholars to address the power of attachment to local government in the current climate of heightened polarization. As a principle of organizing political power, subsidiarity favors devolving political control to the lowest (or smallest) govern- mental entity capable of doing the work. This policy brief explores the lessons for subsidiarity from New York State’s debate over the dissolution of village government. The contestation of which unit of government best serves citizens is rarely partisan; it is, however, often bitterly divisive. This truth thus reaffirms and challenges scholarly conjunctures about political behavior related to matters distinctive to local concerns.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在高度两极分化的政治环境下，地方政府的附着力对权力下放原则（辅助性原则）的影响，以纽约州村庄政府解散辩论为案例研究。
AI.research_question: 在当前高度两极分化的政治环境中，地方政府附着力如何影响辅助性原则的实施？
AI.motivation: 探讨在政治极化加剧的背景下，地方政府作为政治权力组织原则的辅助性原则面临的挑战和机遇。
AI.theoretical_framework: 辅助性原则（subsidiarity）作为政治权力组织原则，强调将政治控制权下放至能够完成工作的最低（或最小）政府实体。
AI.method: 以纽约州村庄政府解散辩论为案例研究，分析地方政府权力下放的争议。
AI.findings: 关于哪个政府单位最能服务公民的争议通常不是党派性的，但往往具有深刻的分歧性，这既证实又挑战了与地方关切相关的政治行为学术假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 对辅助性原则在政治极化环境下的适用性提供了新的理论见解，挑战了关于地方政治行为的传统学术假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者在处理地方政府重组和权力下放争议时提供了实践指导，特别是在高度分化的政治环境中。

title: The Role of Organic Farming in Landscape Conservation
affiliations: University of Strasbourg and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Role of Organic Farming in Landscape Conservation
detail.abstract: Hedgerows support biodiversity, soil protection, and ecosystem resilience, yet their density in France has declined sharply in recent decades. This study investigates whether organic farming promotes hedgerow conservation, using georeferenced farm data from 2015 to 2022 and detailed hedgerow inventories. We estimate cross-sectional and TWFE models to identify the causal effect of organic conversion on hedgerow density. Relative to farms that remained conventional, those that converted to organic farming increased hedgerow density by approximately 0.95 meters per hectare. Moreover, converting farms rapidly converged on the hedgerow level of farms thatwere organic throughout the period, suggesting early adoption of conservation-oriented practices during transition. The positive effect of organic conversion is concentrated in cereal farms, while no significant changes are observed in vineyards or orchards, probably reflecting differences in yield penalties and reliance on ecosystem services across crop types. Policy simulations indicate that targeting hedgerow subsidies on organic and converting farms could more than double the impact per euro spent, reducing the budget needed to meet national restoration goals by up to 60 percent.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨有机农业是否促进树篱保护，发现转为有机农业的农场相比传统农场增加了约0.95米/公顷的树篱密度，且主要集中在谷物农场，对葡萄园和果园影响不显著。政策模拟显示针对有机农场的树篱补贴可大幅提高资金效率。
AI.research_question: 有机农业是否促进树篱保护？
AI.motivation: 法国树篱密度近几十年来急剧下降，树篱对生物多样性、土壤保护和生态系统恢复力具有重要作用
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生态系统服务理论和农业转型理论，探讨有机农业对景观保护的影响
AI.method: 使用2015-2022年地理参考农场数据和详细树篱清单，采用横截面和双向固定效应模型识别有机转换对树篱密度的因果效应
AI.findings: 转为有机农业的农场相比传统农场增加约0.95米/公顷树篱密度；主要集中在谷物农场，葡萄园和果园无显著变化；转换农场迅速达到长期有机农场的树篱水平
AI.theory_contributions: 为有机农业与景观保护的关系提供因果证据，揭示不同作物类型对生态系统服务依赖的差异
AI.practical_contributions: 政策模拟显示针对有机和转换农场的树篱补贴可提高资金效率，减少实现国家恢复目标所需预算达60%

title: Supply-side Problems in Food Loss and Waste Issues in Mitigation through Cold Chain
affiliations: , Nizamiah Observatory Campus - Centre for Economic and Social Studies (CESS) and Independent

detail.title: Supply-side Problems in Food Loss and Waste Issues in Mitigation through Cold Chain

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.

detail.abstract: The food systems approach proposes reducing food loss and waste as a potential solution to achieve food and nutritional security. This is formalised in the Sustainable Development Goals of the United Nations. Despite the issue receiving such ubiquitous recognition, systematic efforts to measure and address FLW are absent in India. Our calculations show that one-sixth of agricultural production, accounting for one-tenth of the gross value added in agriculture, is lost. An efficient cold chain can reduce these losses substantially. However, the concept of an integrated cold chain is still in its infancy in the country, with greater emphasis being placed on single commodity cold storage. Promotional policies like the negotiable warehousing receipt system and the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund have not made an impact. Cold chain development will remain exclusive to export-oriented farmers and traders unless policies are introduced to enable small farmers, farmer producer organisations, and self-help groups to harness its benefits. Relevant start-up innovations can be scaled up through public support. A new institutional mechanism is needed to address the issue of FLW and achieve India's SDGs.

AI.tldr: 印度食品损失和浪费问题严重，占农业产出的六分之一和农业增加值的十分之一。尽管联合国可持续发展目标强调减少食品损失，但印度缺乏系统性的测量和解决措施。整合冷链系统可以有效减少损失，但目前发展不足，政策效果有限。需要新的制度机制来帮助小农户利用冷链技术，实现可持续发展目标。
AI.research_question: 如何通过冷链系统有效减少印度的食品损失和浪费，以实现可持续发展目标？
AI.motivation: 食品损失和浪费是印度实现食品和营养安全的重要障碍，占农业产出的六分之一，但缺乏系统性解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 食品系统方法、可持续发展目标框架、冷链管理理论
AI.method: 计算分析、政策评估、现状调研
AI.findings: 印度食品损失占农业产出的16.7%，冷链系统发展不足，现有政策效果有限，小农户难以受益。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合冷链系统作为减少食品损失的关键机制，强调了制度创新的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的冷链发展建议，包括支持小农户、推广初创企业创新、建立新制度机制。

title: The International Monetary System in the Last and Next 20 Years Redux
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley and Carleton University

detail.title: The International Monetary System in the Last and Next 20 Years Redux
detail.abstract:
In a paper 20 years ago, we analyzed the evolution of the international monetary system over the preceding 20 years and projected its evolution 20 years into the future, on the assumption of unchanged transition probabilities. Here we compare those projections with outcomes and provide new projections, again 20 years into the future. Although the world as a whole has seen financial opening and movement away from intermediate exchange rate regimes, as projected, movement has been slower than projected on the basis of observed transition probabilities in the 20 years preceding our forecast. New projections again based on unchanged transition probabilities but allowing countries to shift between advanced, emerging and developing country groupings and reclassifying exchange rate regimes to accord with current practice again suggest that policy regimes will be modestly different in 2045 than today. There will be a continued decline in intermediate exchange rate arrangements, and gains for hard pegs, as emerging markets move in this direction, and for more freely floating rates, driven by developing countries. There will be a further increase in the share of countries with open capital accounts, driven by emerging markets and developing countries.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了20年前对国际货币体系演变的预测与实际结果，并基于当前数据对未来20年做出新预测。研究发现：金融开放和中间汇率制度减少的趋势符合预期但进展较慢；预计到2045年，中间汇率安排将继续减少，硬钉住和自由浮动汇率将增加，资本账户开放国家比例将进一步提升。
AI.research_question: 国际货币体系的演变趋势如何？20年前的预测与实际发展有何差异？未来20年国际货币体系将如何演变？
AI.motivation: 验证20年前对国际货币体系演变的预测准确性，并基于新的数据对未来发展趋势进行更新预测，为政策制定者和研究者提供参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于历史过渡概率的预测模型，考虑国家分类（发达、新兴、发展中国家）和汇率制度分类的变化。
AI.method: 比较分析法：比较20年前预测与实际结果；预测分析法：基于当前过渡概率对未来20年进行预测，允许国家分类变化和汇率制度重新分类。
AI.findings: 1. 全球金融开放和中间汇率制度减少趋势符合预期但进展慢于预测；2. 预计到2045年中间汇率安排继续减少；3. 硬钉住和自由浮动汇率将增加；4. 资本账户开放国家比例将进一步增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了基于历史过渡概率的预测模型的有效性，为国际货币体系演变理论提供了实证支持，并更新了预测方法以适应当前实践。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供国际货币体系未来演变趋势的参考，帮助各国在汇率制度和资本账户开放方面做出更明智的决策，特别是对新兴市场和发展中国家具有重要指导意义。

title: Fraud at a Distance? How Remote Work Shapes Financial Misconduct
affiliations: Yale School of Management, New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business and

detail.title: Fraud at a Distance? How Remote Work Shapes Financial Misconduct
detail.abstract:
Financial misconduct is often a team activity, facilitated by face-to-face interactions, shared norms, and trust. We exploit the sudden shift to remote work during COVID-19 to examine how workplace organization shapes collusion and financial misconduct. Using a novel firm-level measure of work-from-home feasibility, we find that firms that are more able to operate remotely experienced large post-2020 declines in misconduct. This decline is found across multiple misreporting proxies and is robust to various alternative measures of remote work. Cross-sectional tests indicate stronger declines in teamwork-intensive firms, firms with effective internal controls, and firms with weaker pre-COVID employee perceptions of culture and leadership. Overall, our findings reflect that financial misconduct is a team activity, sensitive to the organizational structure of the firm, with important implications for governance and organizational design.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用COVID-19期间远程工作的突然转变，发现能够远程运营的公司财务不当行为显著减少，表明财务不当行为是团队活动，受组织结构影响。
AI.research_question: 工作场所组织如何影响共谋和财务不当行为？
AI.motivation: 财务不当行为通常是团队活动，通过面对面互动、共享规范和信任来促进。研究利用COVID-19期间远程工作的突然转变来检验这一假设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财务不当行为作为团队活动的理论框架，强调面对面互动、共享规范和信任在促进不当行为中的作用。
AI.method: 使用新颖的公司层面远程工作可行性衡量指标，分析2020年后财务不当行为的变化，并进行横截面测试。
AI.findings: 能够远程运营的公司财务不当行为显著减少，这种减少在团队合作密集的公司、内部控制有效的公司以及COVID前员工对文化和领导力感知较弱的公司中更为明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实财务不当行为是团队活动，对组织结构敏感，为理解组织设计对不当行为的影响提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 对治理和组织设计具有重要启示，建议公司可以通过调整工作场所组织来减少财务不当行为。

title: Optimal Dual-Regime Business Tax Systems
affiliations: Colgate University - Economics Department, University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business, University of Bath - Department of Economics, Michigan State University - Department of Economics and University of Bath - Department of Economics

detail.title: Optimal Dual-Regime Business Tax Systems
detail.abstract:
Dual-regime business tax systems typically subject smaller firms to an output (turnover) tax and larger firms to a profit (corporate) tax. Despite their prevalence, there is little formal analysis of their optimal design. This paper addresses this gap by developing a theoretical framework to analyze the optimal tax parameters and the relative performance of two types of dual-regime systems: threshold and minimum tax systems. We show that either type of dual regime system can yield lower social costs than a single regime system. Using parameter values from recent empirical studies, we also show that a generalized minimum tax system we propose would outperform other dual regime systems under most parameter values. These findings carry important policy implications, particularly as many countries currently employ either threshold or minimum tax systems, but none have yet implemented a generalized minimum tax.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了双轨制企业税制的最优设计，比较了门槛税制和最低税制两种双轨制系统的相对表现，并提出了一种广义最低税制，在大多数参数值下优于其他双轨制系统。
AI.research_question: 双轨制企业税制的最优设计是什么？门槛税制和最低税制哪种系统表现更好？
AI.motivation: 尽管双轨制企业税制在许多国家普遍存在（小企业适用营业额税，大企业适用利润税），但缺乏对其最优设计的正式分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建理论框架分析双轨制税制的最优税收参数，比较门槛税制和最低税制两种系统的相对表现。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，使用近期实证研究的参数值进行模拟。
AI.findings: 1) 两种双轨制系统都能比单一税制系统产生更低的社会成本；2) 提出的广义最低税制在大多数参数值下优于其他双轨制系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了双轨制企业税制最优设计理论分析的空白，提出了广义最低税制的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供重要参考，特别是许多国家目前采用门槛税制或最低税制，但尚未实施广义最低税制。

title: Challenges and Prospects in the Eu’s Proposal to Foster Antimicrobial R&D and Ensure Access

detail.title: Challenges and Prospects in the Eu’s Proposal to Foster Antimicrobial R&D and Ensure Access

declarations.funderStatement: This study was supported by a Novo Nordisk Foundation Grant for a scientifically independent International Collaborative Bioscience Innovation & Law Programme (Inter-CeBIL Programme – Grant No. NNF23SA0087056).

detail.abstract: Antibiotics are fundamental to modern medicine, enabling routine surgery, chemotherapy and treatment of common infections. However, innovation has stagnated, largely targeting known classes that are vulnerable to resistance. Antimicrobial resistance (AMR)-the ability of pathogens to withstand treatment-erodes therapeutic effectiveness and poses substantial health and economic burdens. Addressing AMR requires an integrated strategy that preserves existing agents and rebuilds the pipeline. Traditional incentives, like patents and regulatory exclusivities, do not mitigate the risks associated with development or guarantee returns in a market where antimicrobial R&D often has negative net value. What is needed is a tailored package across the lifecycle: push incentives to finance high-risk early discovery and preclinical work, and pull incentives like market entry rewards, subscription models and, where appropriate, exclusivity vouchers, to support late-stage development, secure predictable revenues and ensure timely access. Experiences from the UK and Sweden show that subscription payments can stabilise supply and even deliver innovation incentives by decoupling revenues from volume. One-off rewards, including transferable exclusivity vouchers, can decouple sales from use, but raise concerns around predictability and conditionality. Ultimately, economic tools must be coupled with stewardship and equitable access, alongside a shift from pay-by-volume to pay-for-provision/access.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出针对抗生素研发创新的综合激励策略，包括推动型激励支持早期研发和拉动型激励确保后期市场回报，以解决抗生素耐药性危机。
AI.research_question: 如何设计有效的经济激励措施来重建抗生素研发管线并解决抗菌素耐药性问题？
AI.motivation: 抗生素创新停滞，传统专利和监管独占权无法解决抗生素研发的负净价值问题，抗菌素耐药性对全球健康和经济构成重大威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生命周期激励理论，结合推动型激励和拉动型激励的整合框架。
AI.method: 分析传统激励机制的局限性，提出综合激励方案，并借鉴英国和瑞典的实践经验。
AI.findings: 订阅支付模式可以稳定供应并激励创新，一次性奖励可以分离销售与使用，但存在可预测性和条件性问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了抗生素研发的全生命周期激励理论框架，提出了从按量付费向按供应/可及性付费的范式转变。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的激励工具组合，包括市场准入奖励、订阅模式和可转让独占权凭证等实用方案。

title: Fast Action for Floods: RCT Evidence on Forecast-based Cash Transfers from Bangladesh and Nepal
affiliations: World Bank - Development Research Group (DIME), , United Nations World Food Programme (WFP), University of Chicago - Harris School of Public Policy, World Bank - Development Research Group (DECRG), University of Chicago, United Nations World Food Programme (WFP), United Nations World Food Programme (WFP),  and United Nations World Food Programme (WFP)

detail.title: Fast Action for Floods: RCT Evidence on Forecast-based Cash Transfers from Bangladesh and Nepal
detail.abstract:
As increasingly frequent extreme weather events disrupt lives, institutions are turning to early-warning systems and advance preparation to accelerate aid delivery. We present evidence from a randomized controlled trial in Bangladesh and Nepal testing whether providing cash within days of a flood leads to greater benefits than delivering the same assistance months later—or if it simply shifts the timing of benefits without improving overall welfare. Results suggest that timely cash assistance leads to overall gains in food security and psychosocial well-being. This evidence supports efforts to forecast crises and release disaster relief quickly.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过孟加拉国和尼泊尔的随机对照试验，验证了洪水发生后几天内提供现金援助相比数月后提供相同援助是否带来更大效益。结果显示及时现金援助能显著改善粮食安全和心理健康状况。
AI.research_question: 在灾害发生后几天内提供现金援助是否比数月后提供相同援助带来更大的整体福利效益？
AI.motivation: 极端天气事件日益频繁，机构希望通过早期预警系统和预先准备来加速援助交付，但需要证据证明及时援助是否真正改善福利而不仅仅是改变受益时间。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于灾害应对和现金援助有效性的理论框架，探讨及时援助对受灾人群福利的影响机制。
AI.method: 在孟加拉国和尼泊尔进行的随机对照试验，比较及时现金援助（洪水后几天内）与延迟现金援助（数月后）的效果差异。
AI.findings: 及时现金援助能带来粮食安全和心理健康方面的整体增益，而不仅仅是改变受益时间。
AI.theory_contributions: 为灾害及时响应理论提供了实证支持，证明及时援助确实能改善受灾人群的长期福利。
AI.practical_contributions: 支持通过危机预测和快速释放灾害救济资金来改善援助效果，为政策制定者提供决策依据。

title: Ideology in Government: Evidence from the Office of Indian Affairs and the Assimilation Era
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin, University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) and

detail.title: Ideology in Government: Evidence from the Office of Indian Affairs and the Assimilation Era
detail.abstract:
This paper studies the ideology of government officials and coercive policymaking by examining the Office of Indian Affairs, an institution that held broad authority over the land, education, and legal governance of Indigenous populations in the United States. We digitize the detailed reports of the agency's bureaucrats and use computational tools to measure the strength of their support for assimilationist policies during the 19th and early 20th centuries. We document major shifts in ideological commitments that coincide with the entry—and eventual exit—of social reformers nominated for high-level agency positions by religious organizations. We find that ideology within the bureaucracy appears to moderate around the turn of the century despite the organization's overall continued pursuit of major assimilation policies, such as the promotion of farming and enrollment in off-reservation Indian boarding schools. To examine performance implications of ideology within the bureaucracy, we conclude with an analysis of policy implementation after the passage of the Dawes Act, a landmark law that aimed to dismantle collective land holdings. We provide evidence showing that the agencies with local staff who express greater past commitment to assimilationist goals carried out more land redistribution immediately after Dawes became law.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析美国印第安事务局的官僚意识形态，研究了政府官员意识形态与强制性政策制定之间的关系。研究发现官僚意识形态会随着宗教组织提名的社会改革者的进入和退出而显著变化，且意识形态影响政策执行效果——对同化政策更支持的机构在《道斯法案》后实施了更多土地重新分配。
AI.research_question: 政府官员的意识形态如何影响强制性政策的制定和执行？
AI.motivation: 理解官僚意识形态在政策制定中的作用，特别是在涉及少数族群的强制性政策中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 官僚意识形态理论、政策执行理论、制度变迁理论
AI.method: 数字化分析印第安事务局官员的详细报告，使用计算工具测量19世纪至20世纪初官员对同化政策的支持程度
AI.findings: 1) 官僚意识形态随宗教组织提名的改革者进入和退出而显著变化；2) 尽管整体追求同化政策，但世纪之交官僚意识形态趋于温和；3) 对同化政策更支持的机构在《道斯法案》后实施了更多土地重新分配
AI.theory_contributions: 为官僚意识形态如何影响政策执行提供了实证证据，扩展了制度变迁理论
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了意识形态在政策执行中的实际影响，为理解历史政策后果提供了新视角

title: The Prestakes of Stock Market Investing
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University, New York University (NYU) - New York University, New York University - Department of Economics and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: The Prestakes of Stock Market Investing
detail.abstract:
How rational is the stock market and how efficiently does it process information? We use machine learning to establish a practical measure of rational and efficient expectation formation while identifying distortions and inefficiencies in the subjective beliefs of market participants. The algorithm independently learns, stays attentive to fundamentals, credit risk, and sentiment, and makes abrupt course-corrections at critical junctures. By contrast, the subjective beliefs of investors, professionals, and equity analysts do little of this and instead contain predictable mistakes–prestakes–that are especially prevalent in times of market turbulence. Trading schemes that bet against prestakes deliver defensive strategies with large CAPM and Fama-French 5-factor alphas.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 使用机器学习评估股票市场的理性程度和信息处理效率，发现市场参与者的主观信念存在可预测的错误（prestakes），特别是在市场动荡时期。通过押注这些错误可以获得防御性策略和显著的超额收益。
AI.research_question: 股票市场有多理性？市场处理信息的效率如何？
AI.motivation: 评估市场参与者的期望形成过程是否理性高效，识别主观信念中的扭曲和低效
AI.theoretical_framework: 理性预期理论、市场效率假说、行为金融学
AI.method: 机器学习算法，分析基本面、信用风险、情绪等因素
AI.findings: 机器学习算法能独立学习、关注基本面并做出及时修正，而投资者、专业人士和分析师的主观信念存在可预测的错误（prestakes），特别是在市场动荡时期
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了衡量理性期望形成的实用方法，识别了市场参与者主观信念中的系统性偏差
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了基于押注prestakes的交易策略，产生了显著的CAPM和Fama-French五因子alpha收益

title: Political Power and Mortality: Heterogeneous Effects of the U.S. Voting Rights Act
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania, Yale University, University of Pennsylvania and

detail.title: Political Power and Mortality: Heterogeneous Effects of the U.S. Voting Rights Act
detail.abstract:
We study the health consequences of redistributing political power through the 1975 extension of the Voting Rights Act, which eliminated barriers to voting for previously disenfranchised nonwhite populations. The intervention led to broad declines in under-five mortality but sharply contrasting effects in other age groups: mortality fell among non-white children, younger adults, and older women, yet rose among whites and older non-white men. These differences cannot be reconciled by changes in population composition or material conditions. Instead, we present evidence suggesting psychosocial stress and retaliatory responses arising from perceived status threat as key mechanisms.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 1975年投票权法案扩展通过重新分配政治权力，消除了非白人人口的投票障碍，对健康产生了复杂影响：5岁以下儿童死亡率普遍下降，但在其他年龄组出现截然不同的效应——非白人儿童、年轻成人和老年女性死亡率下降，而白人和老年非白人男性死亡率上升。这些差异无法用人口构成或物质条件变化解释，而是与心理社会压力和地位威胁感知相关的报复性反应有关。
AI.research_question: 1975年投票权法案扩展如何影响不同人群的健康结果？其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究政治权力重新分配对健康的影响，特别是投票权扩展如何通过社会心理机制影响不同人群的健康状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政治权力重新分配理论、社会地位威胁理论和心理社会压力理论，探讨投票权扩展对健康的影响机制。
AI.method: 利用1975年投票权法案扩展作为准自然实验，分析该政策对不同人群死亡率的影响，并检验人口构成、物质条件和心理社会机制的解释力。
AI.findings: 投票权扩展导致5岁以下儿童死亡率普遍下降，但对其他年龄组产生异质性影响：非白人儿童、年轻成人和老年女性死亡率下降，而白人和老年非白人男性死亡率上升。这些差异主要由心理社会压力和地位威胁感知驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了政治权力重新分配通过社会心理机制影响健康的新理论框架，深化了对投票权与健康关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于投票权扩展健康效应的实证证据，强调了需要考虑政策对不同人群的异质性影响和社会心理后果。

title: We Won't be Missed: Work and Growth in the AGI World
affiliations: Yale University

detail.title: We Won't be Missed: Work and Growth in the AGI World
detail.abstract:
This chapter explores the long-run implications of Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) for economic growth and labor markets. AGI makes it feasible to perform all economically valuable work using compute. I distinguish between bottleneck and supplementary work—tasks that are essential versus non-essential for unhindered growth. As computational resources expand: (i) the economy automates all bottleneck work, (ii) some supplementary work may be left exclusively to humans, (iii) output becomes linear in compute and labor and its growth is driven by the expansion of compute, (iv) wages converge to the opportunity cost of computational resources required to reproduce human work, and (v) the share of labor income in GDP converges to zero.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了通用人工智能对经济增长和劳动力市场的长期影响，指出当计算资源扩张时，经济将自动化所有瓶颈工作，产出与计算资源呈线性关系，工资收敛于复制人类工作所需计算资源的机会成本，劳动收入占GDP比重趋近于零。
AI.research_question: 通用人工智能对经济增长和劳动力市场的长期影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着通用人工智能的发展，理解其对经济结构和劳动力市场的根本性变革具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于计算经济学和人工智能经济学理论，区分瓶颈工作与补充性工作。
AI.method: 理论建模和分析方法，探讨计算资源扩张对经济结构的影响。
AI.findings: 随着计算资源扩张：(1)经济自动化所有瓶颈工作；(2)部分补充性工作可能专属于人类；(3)产出与计算资源和劳动力呈线性关系；(4)工资收敛于复制人类工作所需计算资源的机会成本；(5)劳动收入占GDP比重趋近于零。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了通用人工智能时代经济增长的新理论框架，明确了计算资源在经济增长中的核心地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了应对通用人工智能时代劳动力市场变革的理论依据，有助于制定相应的教育和就业政策。

title: The Price of Intelligence: How Should Socially-minded Firms Price and Deploy AI?
affiliations: and Yale University

detail.title: The Price of Intelligence: How Should Socially-minded Firms Price and Deploy AI?
detail.abstract:
Leading AI firms claim to prioritize social welfare. How should firms with a social mandate price and deploy AI? We derive pricing formulas that depart from profit maximization by incorporating incentives to improve welfare and reduce labor disruptions. Using US data, we evaluate several scenarios. A welfarist firm that values both profit and welfare should price closer to marginal cost, as efficiency gains outweigh distributional concerns. A conservative firm focused on labor-market stability should price above the profit-maximizing level in the short run, especially when its AI may displace low-income workers. Overall, socially minded firms face a trade-off between expanding access to AI and the resulting loss in profits and labor market risks.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了具有社会使命的AI公司应如何定价和部署AI技术。研究发现，重视社会福利的公司应将价格定在接近边际成本，而关注劳动力市场稳定的保守公司应在短期内定价高于利润最大化水平。
AI.research_question: 具有社会使命的AI公司应如何定价和部署AI技术？
AI.motivation: 领先的AI公司声称优先考虑社会福利，但如何在实际操作中平衡利润和社会目标尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 偏离利润最大化的定价模型，纳入改善福利和减少劳动力市场扰动的激励机制。
AI.method: 使用美国数据进行情景分析，评估不同社会目标下的定价策略。
AI.findings: 重视福利的公司应定价接近边际成本，而关注劳动力市场稳定的公司应在短期内定价高于利润最大化水平，特别是当AI可能替代低收入工人时。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了包含社会目标的AI定价理论框架，超越了传统的利润最大化模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI公司提供了在追求社会目标时的具体定价指导，帮助平衡技术普及与劳动力市场风险。

title: Same Crime, Different Time: Disparities in Judicial Outcomes for DWI Offenders
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin, University of Oregon - Department of Economics, Brigham Young University - Department of Economics, Brigham Young University and University of Texas at Austin

detail.title: Same Crime, Different Time: Disparities in Judicial Outcomes for DWI Offenders
detail.abstract:
We examine disparities in judicial outcomes among people charged with Driving While Intoxicated (DWI), a setting in which legal guilt is objectively determined by breath alcohol content (BrAC). Focusing on first-time offenders with no aggravating circumstances and BrAC above the legal threshold, we find that race, gender, and financial resources strongly predict the likelihood of incarceration and case dismissal. Defendants with greater socioeconomic advantage are more likely to access rehabilitative alternatives and avoid criminal records. We discuss how these outcome differences may reflect not only disparities in options offered by the court, but also in defendants’ choices among them.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了醉酒驾驶案件中的司法结果差异，发现在法律有罪证据明确的情况下，种族、性别和经济资源仍强烈预测监禁可能性和案件驳回率。社会经济优势的被告更可能获得康复替代方案并避免犯罪记录。
AI.research_question: 在醉酒驾驶案件中，当法律有罪证据客观明确时，种族、性别和经济资源如何影响司法结果？
AI.motivation: 研究在证据客观明确的法律案件中是否存在司法结果差异，以排除法律有罪不确定性对分析的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 司法不平等理论、社会经济地位与司法结果关系理论、替代性制裁选择理论
AI.method: 分析首次醉酒驾驶且无加重情节、酒精含量超过法定标准的案件数据
AI.findings: 种族、性别和财务资源强烈预测监禁可能性和案件驳回率；社会经济优势被告更可能获得康复替代方案并避免犯罪记录
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了即使在法律有罪证据明确的情况下，司法系统中仍存在系统性不平等；扩展了对替代性制裁选择机制的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为司法改革提供实证依据，建议改进替代性制裁的公平分配机制；帮助政策制定者设计更公平的司法程序

title: An Inverse-Ramsey Tax Rule
affiliations: University of Milan, University of Hawaii at Manoa, University of Maryland and University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business

detail.title: An Inverse-Ramsey Tax Rule
detail.abstract:
Traditional optimal commodity tax analysis, dating back to Ramsey (1927), prescribes that to maximize welfare one should impose higher taxes on goods with lower demand elasticities. Yet policy makers do not stress minimizing efficiency costs as a desideratum. In this note we revisit the commodity tax problem, and show that the attractiveness of the Ramsey inverse-elasticity prescription can itself be inverted if the tax system is chosen – or at least strongly influenced – by taxpayers who are overly confident of their ability, relative to others, to substitute away from taxed goods.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了传统的最优商品税理论，指出当纳税人过度自信其避税能力时，拉姆齐逆弹性法则可能失效。
AI.research_question: 当纳税人过度自信其避税能力时，最优商品税结构会发生什么变化？
AI.motivation: 传统拉姆齐税制强调对需求弹性低的商品征收高税，但政策制定者并不总是遵循这一原则。本文探讨纳税人过度自信如何影响最优税制设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拉姆齐最优商品税理论、行为经济学中的过度自信理论
AI.method: 理论模型分析，重新构建最优商品税问题框架
AI.findings: 当纳税人过度自信其避税能力时，传统的逆弹性法则可能被逆转，即对高弹性商品征收更高税率可能更优
AI.theory_contributions: 将行为经济学中的过度自信概念引入最优税收理论，拓展了传统拉姆齐税制的分析框架

title: The Role of Private Debt in the Financial Ecosystem
affiliations: Harvard University

detail.title: The Role of Private Debt in the Financial Ecosystem
detail.abstract:
This paper provides a comprehensive introduction to private debt, examines the key drivers behind its expansion, and frames the discussion around potential risk accumulation in the broader economy. Overall, the development of private debt can be viewed as the emergence of a new technology that facilitated the expansion of the high-yield corporate debt market into the middle market. Throughout its history, the evolution of the high-yield debt and the rise of private debt have been closely intertwined with the growth of private equity. Historically, banks have not had significant exposure to financing buyouts or other highly leveraged transactions, whether in the large-cap or mid-cap segments.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文全面介绍了私募债务的发展，分析了其扩张的关键驱动因素，并围绕其在更广泛经济中可能积累的风险展开讨论。私募债务的发展可被视为一种新技术，促进了高收益公司债市场向中等市场的扩张。

title: The Effectiveness of Economic Sanctions: A Comparative Analysis of South Africa and Russia
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Effectiveness of Economic Sanctions: A Comparative Analysis of South Africa and Russia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: In partnership with the Lumiere Research Program, I developed this research paper under the guidance of a Harvard PH.D candidate Mijoo Shin.

contentType.other: Scholarly work conducted under the guidance of a Harvard academic (Final Paper)

detail.abstract: Economic sanctions have increasingly become a tool to initiate geo-political transformation. However, these measures have warranted mixed results. While, leveraging resources accelerated change in some nations, they have had minimal impacts on others. Scholars have long examined the various factors that could contribute to such a difference in effectiveness (political structures, economic stability, international alliances). Though these papers provide meaningful insights, they often treat these factors in isolation rather than taking into account the interplay between national and international dynamics as well as the activeness of the targeted state. This study seeks to remedy this shortcoming through a comparative study of the impacts of economic sanctions on South Africa and Russia through the novel Domestic Resilience Framework. South Africa’s experience with sanctions in response to Apartheid serves as a case study as to where international pressure in conjunction with domestic resistance can lead to significant political change. On the flipside, Russia has withstood the plethora of economic sanctions levied against them in response to their invasion against Ukraine and has maintained their political status quo. By comparing South Africa’s liberalization to Russia’s continued militarism, this study aims to provide clarity of the complex dynamics that determines the usefulness of economic sanctions, and the conditions under which they are most likely to succeed.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过比较南非和俄罗斯的经济制裁案例，提出了国内韧性框架来解释制裁效果的差异。研究发现，制裁成功与否取决于目标国国内抵抗与国际压力的相互作用，而不仅仅是孤立因素。
AI.research_question: 经济制裁在什么条件下最可能成功？为什么同样的制裁措施在南非导致政治变革，而在俄罗斯却未能改变其政治现状？
AI.motivation: 现有研究往往孤立分析影响制裁效果的因素（政治结构、经济稳定、国际联盟），而忽视了国内与国际动态的相互作用以及目标国的主动性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国内韧性框架（Domestic Resilience Framework），强调目标国国内抵抗与国际压力的相互作用对制裁效果的决定性作用。
AI.method: 比较案例研究法，以南非（种族隔离时期）和俄罗斯（入侵乌克兰后）的经济制裁案例进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 制裁成功需要国内抵抗与国际压力的协同作用。南非案例显示国内抵抗与国际压力结合能促成政治变革，而俄罗斯案例表明缺乏国内抵抗时制裁效果有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了国内韧性框架，将国内与国际因素整合分析，弥补了现有研究孤立分析因素的不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更准确评估制裁效果的框架，帮助识别制裁可能成功的条件，避免无效制裁造成的资源浪费。

title: Vulnerability of the Public Safety System: Evidence from Micro-Shocks
affiliations: Wayne State University - Department of Economics, Syracuse University, George Mason University and Indiana University Bloomington

detail.title: Vulnerability of the Public Safety System: Evidence from Micro-Shocks
detail.abstract:
The 911 system, a vital component of public safety, responds to over 210 million emergency calls each year. We examine the effect of small exogenous public health stressors – pollen emissions – on the operation of the 911 call system in Seattle, Washington. Leveraging daily variation in pollen levels, we evaluate pollen’s impact on the volume of 911 calls. We find that a 100% increase in pollen levels – the modal day-over-day variation we observe in our data – results in six additional 911 calls per day. We further show that elevated pollen levels influence the quality of emergency and non-emergency response. The 911 system responds to increased strain by prioritizing more urgent calls – and as a result, increasing response time to non-urgent calls. Though all calls are connected to a dispatcher, there are increased missed connections – canceled emergency response, missing records of response, and false reports. Despite the prioritization of urgent calls, these additional daily calls lead to reallocation of resources in ways that potentially impede service quality. Thus, our findings suggest that common and small shocks may lead to under-provision of valuable services to communities across the U.S.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究发现花粉排放这种小型公共卫生压力源会增加911紧急呼叫系统的负担，导致响应质量下降，资源重新分配可能影响服务质量。
AI.research_question: 小型外生公共卫生压力源（花粉排放）如何影响911紧急呼叫系统的运作？
AI.motivation: 911系统每年处理超过2.1亿个紧急呼叫，是公共安全的重要组成部分，需要了解小型压力源对其运作的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共资源配置理论、应急响应系统效率理论
AI.method: 利用华盛顿州西雅图市花粉水平的日变化数据，评估花粉对911呼叫量的影响
AI.findings: 花粉水平增加100%（数据中观察到的典型日变化）会导致每天增加6个911呼叫；花粉水平升高影响紧急和非紧急响应质量；系统通过优先处理更紧急的呼叫来应对压力，但增加了非紧急呼叫的响应时间；出现更多错过的连接、取消的紧急响应、缺失的响应记录和虚假报告
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了小型公共卫生压力源对关键公共服务系统运作的显著影响，拓展了公共服务资源配置理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为911系统管理者提供了应对季节性压力源的策略建议，有助于改善公共安全服务的资源配置效率

title: The GATT vs Inflation: Tokyo Drift
affiliations: North Carolina State University,  and College of William and Mary - Department of Economics

detail.title: The GATT vs Inflation: Tokyo Drift
detail.abstract:
This paper demonstrates that ignoring the source of variation in tariff levels yields misleading conclusions regarding the effects of tariff changes. Specifically, we show that changes in the ad valorem equivalent (AVE) tariff are insufficient to quantify the magnitude or sign of the effect of tariff changes on economic outcomes. To illustrate this point, we construct the first database of annual US statutory tariffs from 1972 to 1988 and use it to explore the consequences of liberalization in the years spanning the Tokyo Round of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT). Decomposing the aggregate AVE into its statutory and endogenous components, we document two distinct liberalizations in our sample. Prior to 1979, inflation combines with specific tariffs to create an “accidental liberalization”, despite the absence of widespread statutory tariff changes. After 1979, endogenous changes in the composition of imports mask the large Tokyo Round statutory tariff liberalization. Generalizing an exact hat framework to accommodate specific tariffs, we show that inflation-driven reductions in AVEs account for roughly half of the tariff liberalization in our sample, but these changes ultimately reduce imports and welfare. Finally, we show that specific tariffs remain an important determinant of cross-sectional variation in AVEs: between 2000 and 2017, one-third to one-half of the annual cross-sectional variance in good-level AVEs is driven by variation in the AVE of specific tariffs.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文证明忽略关税水平变化来源会导致对关税变化经济影响的误导性结论。研究发现从价等值关税变化不足以量化关税变化对经济结果的影响程度和方向。通过构建1972-1988年美国法定关税数据库，揭示了两种不同的自由化过程：1979年前的通胀与从量关税导致"意外自由化"，1979年后进口构成的内生变化掩盖了东京回合的法定关税自由化。
AI.research_question: 关税变化的不同来源如何影响关税自由化对经济结果的影响评估？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常仅关注从价等值关税变化，但忽略了关税变化的不同来源可能对经济影响产生不同的效应，这可能导致对关税自由化效果的误导性结论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展了精确帽子框架以容纳从量关税，区分法定关税和内生关税变化对经济影响的不同机制。
AI.method: 构建1972-1988年美国年度法定关税数据库，分解总体从价等值关税为法定和内生组成部分，分析东京回合GATT期间的关税自由化过程。
AI.findings: 1) 1979年前通胀与从量关税导致"意外自由化"但实际减少进口和福利；2) 1979年后进口构成内生变化掩盖了东京回合法定关税自由化；3) 2000-2017年间从量关税仍是从价等值关税横截面变异的重要决定因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统区分关税变化的不同来源对经济影响的异质性效应，扩展了关税分析的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更准确的关税自由化评估工具，强调了考虑关税变化来源的重要性，避免基于简单从价等值关税变化的误导性政策结论。

title: The Value of Banking Relationships
affiliations: National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER) and

detail.title: The Value of Banking Relationships
detail.abstract:
Commercial banking is an industry in which long-term, nonexclusive relationships between bankers and their borrowers are governed by short-term contracts. This paper documents the nature of bank-borrower relationships in a historical setting. We use a new dataset of 55,000 loans to 10,000 unique borrowers over 35 years in the mid-nineteenth century. Two-way fixed effects models reveal that a one standard deviation increase in the number of previous loans leads to an increase in loan size by 4.72%. A one-year increase in the duration of a relationship leads to an increase in loan size of 5.6%. Relationships have small effects on loan rates, but substantial effects on collateral. Borrowers with relationships with competing banks receive substantially smaller loans. Propensity score matching reveals that banks learn about borrowers early in the relationship. Finally, the bank severed relationships with about half of the borrowers who defaulted on a loan. A surviving relationship becomes more valuable after default.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了19世纪中期银行与借款人关系的性质，发现关系持续时间越长、贷款次数越多，贷款规模越大，但对利率影响较小。关系对抵押品要求有显著影响，与竞争银行有关系的借款人获得贷款更少。银行在关系早期了解借款人，违约后约半数关系被终止，但幸存的关系价值更高。
AI.research_question: 银行与借款人关系的性质及其对贷款条款的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 商业银行行业中长期的非排他性关系由短期合同管理，需要了解这种关系的历史特征和影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行-借款人关系理论、信息不对称理论、关系银行理论
AI.method: 使用19世纪中期55,000笔贷款和10,000个借款人的新数据集，采用双向固定效应模型和倾向得分匹配方法
AI.findings: 1. 先前贷款数量增加一个标准差，贷款规模增加4.72%；2. 关系持续时间增加一年，贷款规模增加5.6%；3. 关系对利率影响小，但对抵押品要求影响大；4. 与竞争银行有关系的借款人获得更少贷款；5. 银行在关系早期了解借款人；6. 违约后约半数关系被终止，幸存关系价值更高
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对历史背景下银行-借款人关系动态的理解，验证了关系银行理论在历史环境中的适用性
AI.practical_contributions: 为现代银行关系管理提供历史借鉴，揭示了关系建立和维护的关键因素

title: Pushing Back Against Private Practice: The Unintended Effects of Paying Public Doctors More
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics, University of Navarra - IESE Business School, University of Barcelona and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)

detail.title: Pushing Back Against Private Practice: The Unintended Effects of Paying Public Doctors More
detail.abstract:
Most nations in the world have side-by-side private and public health care systems. Policymakers worry that “dual practice” across sectors might reduce care to the public sector. This concern led regions in Spain to offer “exclusivity bonuses” to physicians who practice exclusively in the public sector. We show theoretically that the impact of these bonuses on the public sector is ambiguous. We demonstrate empirically that the bonuses backfired: they did increase exclusive participation in the public sector, but significantly reduced hours of work. When regions added offsetting bonuses for dual practice, they were largely ineffective.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: The Impact of Propaganda and Corruption on Democracies
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Impact of Propaganda and Corruption on Democracies

contentType.other: Scholarly work reviewed by UCI academic (Final Paper)

detail.abstract: This review assesses the boundaries and qualities of a well-functioning democracy in contrast with three present-day democracies: the United States of America, Costa Rica, and Brazil. The intricacies and contrasts between the countries are examined, as are their varying views on popular social and economic issues. The review then looks at how each country’s democracies operated before propaganda and hate speech became institutionalized utilizing secondary sources and indices and took note of the country's overall standing. Furthermore, the paper delves into how, after hate speech and propaganda became prevalent, each country was impacted. Afterwards, the review narrows in  on speech and misinformation and how they are the biggest threats to our democracy by demonstrating how these three societies are becoming more and more like authoritarian countries. The paper concludes by discussing possible solutions to maintain democratic ideals, arguing that, if these target reforms are passed, democracy will be self-correcting.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较美国、哥斯达黎加和巴西三个民主国家的运作，分析了宣传和仇恨言论制度化对民主的威胁，并提出了维护民主理想的解决方案。
AI.research_question: 宣传和仇恨言论如何威胁现代民主国家的民主运作？
AI.motivation: 研究当前民主国家面临的宣传和仇恨言论威胁，以及这些威胁如何使民主国家向威权主义转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民主理论、言论自由理论、宣传理论、威权主义转型理论
AI.method: 使用二手资料和指数进行跨国比较分析
AI.findings: 宣传和仇恨言论的制度化使美国、哥斯达黎加和巴西三个民主社会越来越接近威权国家，言论和错误信息是民主面临的最大威胁。

AI.practical_contributions: 为维护民主理想提供了具体的改革建议，帮助民主国家应对宣传和仇恨言论的威胁

title: Modeling and Measuring the Genetic Determinants of Child Development
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania and University of Pennsylvania

detail.title: Modeling and Measuring the Genetic Determinants of Child Development
detail.abstract:
The longstanding debate over whether human capabilities and skills are shaped more by “nature” or “nurture” has been revitalized by recent advances in genetics, particularly in the use of polygenic scores (PGSs) to proxy for genetic endowments. Yet, we argue that PGSs embed not only direct genetic effects but also indirect environmental influences, raising questions about their validity for causal analysis. We show that these conflated measures can mislead studies of gene–environment interactions, especially when parental behavior responds to children’s genetic risk. To address this issue, we construct a new latent measure of genetic risk that integrates individual genotypes with diagnostic symptoms, using data from the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent to Adult Health linked to restricted individual SNP-level genotypes from dbGaP. Exploiting multiple sources of variation—including the Mendelian within-family genetic randomization among siblings—we find consistent evidence that parents compensate by investing more in children with higher genetic risk for ADHD. Strikingly, these compensatory responses disappear when genetic risk is proxied by the conventional ADHD PGS, which also yields weaker—and in some cases reversed—predictions for long-run outcomes. Finally, we embed our latent measure of genetic endowments into a standard dynamic structural model of child development. The model shows that both parental investments and latent genetic risk jointly shape children’s cognitive and mental health development, underscoring the importance of modeling the dynamic interplay between genes and environments in the formation of human capital.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文批评传统多基因评分(PGS)在因果分析中的局限性，构建了整合基因型和诊断症状的潜在遗传风险测量方法，发现父母会对ADHD遗传风险较高的孩子进行补偿性投资，而传统PGS会掩盖这些动态基因-环境互动。
AI.research_question: 如何准确测量遗传风险以研究基因-环境互动？传统多基因评分(PGS)在因果分析中存在哪些问题？
AI.motivation: 近期遗传学进展特别是多基因评分的应用重新激发了关于"先天与后天"的争论，但PGS不仅包含直接遗传效应还包含间接环境影响，其因果有效性受到质疑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基因-环境互动理论、人类资本形成理论、动态结构模型
AI.method: 使用国家青少年至成人健康纵向研究数据，结合dbGaP的SNP水平基因型数据，利用孟德尔家庭内随机化等变异来源，构建潜在遗传风险测量方法
AI.findings: 父母会对ADHD遗传风险较高的孩子进行补偿性投资；传统ADHD PGS会掩盖这些补偿性反应，并对长期结果产生较弱甚至相反的预测；潜在遗传禀赋和父母投资共同塑造儿童的认知和心理健康发展
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了更准确的遗传风险测量方法，揭示了基因-环境动态互动的复杂性，挑战了传统PGS的因果推断有效性
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更准确的遗传风险评估工具，强调了在儿童发展干预中考虑基因-环境互动的重要性

title: Planes Overhead: How Airplane Noise Impacts Home Values
affiliations: , Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Center for Energy and Environmental Policy Research (CEEPR), Tufts University, University of Connecticut and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)

detail.title: Planes Overhead: How Airplane Noise Impacts Home Values
detail.abstract:
Air transportation supports economic growth and global connectivity but imposes localized environmental costs, particularly through aircraft noise. We estimate the causal effect of aviation noise on housing prices using quasi-experimental variation from the Federal Aviation Administration's rollout of performance-based navigation (PBN) procedures and runway reconfigurations at three major U.S. airports. Combining high-resolution flight trajectory data with geocoded housing transactions, we apply a difference-in-differences hedonic framework to identify changes in exposure unanticipated by residents. A one-decibel increase in annual day-night average sound level reduces house prices by 0.6 to 1.0 percent. Among alternative noise metrics, average exposure explains property value impacts most strongly. Willingness to pay for quieter conditions varies systematically with income and race, indicating that aircraft noise externalities have meaningful distributional consequences. Our results highlight the need to incorporate localized environmental costs into aviation and urban land-use policy.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用准实验方法估计飞机噪音对房价的因果效应，发现每增加1分贝的年均日夜间平均声级会使房价下降0.6-1.0%。噪音外部性存在明显的收入与种族分布差异。
AI.research_question: 飞机噪音对住房价格的因果效应是什么？噪音外部性是否存在收入与种族分布差异？
AI.motivation: 航空运输支持经济增长和全球连通性，但带来了局部环境成本，特别是飞机噪音问题。需要量化这些外部性对房地产市场的影响及其分布后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于享乐价格理论，将噪音作为住房属性之一，分析其对房价的影响；使用准实验方法识别因果关系。
AI.method: 采用双重差分享乐框架，利用美国联邦航空管理局性能导航程序推出和跑道重新配置的准实验变异，结合高分辨率飞行轨迹数据和地理编码住房交易数据。
AI.findings: 年均日夜间平均声级每增加1分贝，房价下降0.6-1.0%；平均暴露度最能解释房产价值影响；支付安静环境的意愿随收入和种族系统变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了飞机噪音对房价因果效应的可靠估计；揭示了噪音外部性在收入与种族维度的分布差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调需要在航空和城市土地利用政策中考虑局部环境成本；为政策制定者提供噪音外部性分布后果的证据支持。

title: Political Information and Network Effects
affiliations: Northwestern University - Kellogg School of Management, Institut d'Etudes Politiques de Paris (Sciences Po), Fundación Instituto de Empresa, S.L. - IE Business School and Paris School of Economics (PSE)

detail.title: Political Information and Network Effects
detail.abstract:
Why do political campaigns so often yield unexpected results? We address this question by separately estimating the direct effect of a campaign on targeted voters and the indirect effect on others in the same social environment. Partnering with a local NGO during Argentina’s 2023 presidential election, we randomized the distribution of leaflets providing an expert assessment of the likely consequences of certain proposals by the outsider candidate Javier Milei. Exploiting Argentina’s unique sub-precinct election reporting system, we show that the campaign reduced Milei’s support among directly treated voters, as expected, but increased his support among untreated voters in treated precincts, producing a backfiring, net-positive effect for Milei. A pre-registered replication confirmed these opposite-signed effects. Using theory and a survey experiment, we show that the minority of voters who disbelieved the campaign were more motivated to discuss it with peers, convincing them to support Milei. This mobilization effect appears especially likely when campaigns criticize outsider candidates. Our results highlight how campaigns aimed at anti-elite candidates can unintentionally mobilize support for them.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，在阿根廷2023年总统选举中，针对外来候选人哈维尔·米莱的负面竞选传单虽然降低了直接接触者的支持率，但却通过社会网络效应增加了未接触者的支持，最终产生了适得其反的净正面效果。
AI.research_question: 为什么政治竞选活动经常产生意想不到的结果？竞选活动对目标选民和其他社会环境中的人分别产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 解释政治竞选活动为何经常产生意外结果，特别是针对反建制候选人的竞选活动可能适得其反的现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会影响理论、政治动员理论、竞选效果理论
AI.method: 与当地NGO合作，在阿根廷2023年总统选举期间随机分发传单，利用阿根廷独特的子选区选举报告系统，结合调查实验。
AI.findings: 竞选活动降低了直接接触传单的选民对米莱的支持，但增加了同一选区中未接触传单选民的支持，产生了适得其反的净正面效果。少数不相信竞选信息的选民更倾向于与同伴讨论，说服他们支持米莱。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了竞选活动通过社会网络产生的间接效应，特别是针对反建制候选人的批评性竞选可能产生适得其反的动员效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政治竞选策略提供重要启示，表明针对外来候选人的负面竞选可能适得其反，反而动员更多支持者。

title: Modeling the Dynamics of the Mauritian Economy: A Multivariate Time Series Approach
affiliations: , Illinois Institute of Technology - Department of Computer Science and Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Kumasi, Ghana.

detail.title: Modeling the Dynamics of the Mauritian Economy: A Multivariate Time Series Approach
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the dynamic interrelationships among key macroeconomic indicators of the Mauritian economy-oil prices, the monetary policy rate (MPR), the exchange rate (USDMUR), and year-on-year inflation-using monthly data spanning January 2014 to March 2025. A Vector Error Correction Model (VECM) is estimated to capture both short-run dynamics and long-run equilibrium relationships among the variables. Augmented Dickey-Fuller (ADF) unit root tests confirm that all series are integrated of order one. Lag selection criteria indicate a three-lag optimal structure, and Johansen's cointegration test identifies one long-run cointegrating relationship, confirming the presence of stable equilibrium. Diagnostic checks using the Ljung-Box test confirm the absence of serial correlation. Empirical results show that oil prices significantly influence monetary policy in the short run, while inflation exhibits strong persistence. The error correction term reveals that only the monetary policy rate (MPR) significantly and negatively adjusts toward long-run equilibrium, correcting about 0.05% of disequilibrium each month. This highlights the stabilizing role of monetary policy in restoring long-run balance following short-run macroeconomic shocks in Mauritius.

AI.tldr: 本文使用VECM模型研究毛里求斯宏观经济指标间的动态关系，发现油价短期显著影响货币政策，通胀具有强持续性，货币政策利率是唯一显著向长期均衡调整的变量，每月修正约0.05%的不均衡。
AI.research_question: 毛里求斯经济中油价、货币政策利率、汇率和通胀之间的动态相互关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解毛里求斯宏观经济变量间的短期动态和长期均衡关系，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 向量误差修正模型(VECM)、单位根检验、协整理论
AI.method: 使用2014年1月至2025年3月的月度数据，采用ADF单位根检验、Johansen协整检验和VECM模型分析
AI.findings: 油价短期显著影响货币政策；通胀具有强持续性；只有货币政策利率显著负向调整向长期均衡，每月修正0.05%的不均衡
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了毛里求斯宏观经济变量间存在稳定的长期均衡关系，并识别了货币政策在恢复长期平衡中的关键作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为毛里求斯央行制定货币政策提供了实证支持，强调了货币政策在应对宏观经济冲击中的稳定作用

reference: Wentong Zheng, Presidential Tariffs, 63 San Diego L. Rev. ___ (forthcoming 2026)
title: Presidential Tariffs
affiliations: University of Florida Levin College of Law

detail.title: Presidential Tariffs

publicationDetails.detailsText: Wentong Zheng, Presidential Tariffs, 63 San Diego L. Rev. ___ (forthcoming 2026)

detail.abstract:
The Constitution of the United States grants the power to lay and collect tariffs exclusively to Congress. Yet for almost a century, the President has gradually asserted control over the most significant aspects of the U.S. tariff policy. This crescendo of presidential tariff power culminated in the imposition of worldwide “reciprocal” tariffs under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (“IEEPA”) by the second Trump Administration.

This Article analyzes the proper contour of the presidential tariff power under the IEEPA from the lenses of both statutory interpretation and constitutional separation of powers. The Article traces three major discretionary authorities over tariffs that Congress has delegated to the President: the trade agreements authority, the national security authority, and the international emergency authority. This Article argues that these three discretionary authorities need to be analyzed holistically, across statutory schemes when dissecting whether Congress has delegated a tariff authority under the IEEPA and whether such delegation violates the nondelegation doctrine.

Utilizing this cross-statutory interpretative approach, this Article argues that when interpreting the IEEPA, courts have oversimplified or outright overlooked key complexities regarding the IEEPA’s textual ambiguities and constitutional dilemmas, and the direct conflict between a tariff authority under the IEEPA and the expiration of the trade agreements tariff proclamation authority. These complexities put the Supreme Court in an unenviable position of creating legal and policy dilemmas no matter how it rules on the tariff authority under the IEEPA. This Article argues that the ultimate solution to these dilemmas lies with Congress, which has the power to clarify its intent through an interbranch dialogue that recalibrates the presidential tariff power to the current circumstances. This Article recounts how two earlier episodes of this interbranch dialogue, during the Johnson and Nixon administrations respectively, led to the current legal quagmires on the IEEPA, and lays out the options for Congress in the current round of this interbranch dialogue.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国总统在《国际紧急经济权力法》(IEEPA)下的关税权力，认为法院在解释IEEPA时过度简化了文本模糊性和宪法困境，建议国会通过跨部门对话重新调整总统关税权力。
AI.research_question: 美国总统在IEEPA下的关税权力的适当边界是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管美国宪法将关税权力授予国会，但近一个世纪来总统逐渐控制了美国关税政策的最重要方面，特朗普政府时期达到顶峰。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法定解释和宪法分权理论，非授权原则
AI.method: 跨法规解释方法，分析国会授予总统的三个主要关税自由裁量权：贸易协定权、国家安全权和国际紧急权力
AI.findings: 法院在解释IEEPA时过度简化或忽视了文本模糊性和宪法困境，以及IEEPA下的关税权力与贸易协定关税公告权到期之间的直接冲突
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了跨法规解释方法，强调需要整体分析三个关税自由裁量权
AI.practical_contributions: 为国会提供了在当前跨部门对话中重新调整总统关税权力的选择方案

title: Voting with Their Feet: Democratic Backsliding and Market-Minded Migration - Evidence from Israel and Europe
affiliations: Tel Aviv University - Eitan Berglas School of Economics

detail.title: Voting with Their Feet: Democratic Backsliding and Market-Minded Migration - Evidence from Israel and Europe
detail.abstract:
Using a comparative framework, the study examines how variations in political regimes across Israel and Europe shape patterns of international migration. In both contexts, episodes of democratic backsliding serve as quasi-exogenous shocks that reveal the causal link between institutional erosion and outward mobility.In Israel, the origin of democratic backsliding lies in a corruption shock—the criminal indictment of the prime minister—which escalated into an executive–judicial shock as the government launched an anti-democratic judicial overhaul. This confrontation between the executive and judiciary provides a natural experiment for identifying how institutional breakdowns shape migration decisions.In Europe, the origin of democratic backsliding stems from a “Syrian shock”—a massive refugee inflow that strained administrative capacity, polarized politics, and weakened liberal institutions. The resulting governance erosion triggered emigration responses structurally like those observed in Israel.Using a difference-in-differences (DiD) estimation, the study identifies causal effects of democratic erosion on migration flows. Across both settings, out-migration emerges as a market-minded response to illiberal regime change—a behavioral signal of sensitivity to policies that features nationalizing industries, restrict free speech, and undermine the rule of law. Together, the Israeli and European experiences demonstrate that illiberal governance functions as a systemic push factor for emigration, beyond standard economic explanations.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过比较以色列和欧洲的政治体制差异，探讨民主倒退如何影响国际移民模式。研究发现，无论是在以色列（由腐败和司法改革引发的民主倒退）还是在欧洲（由叙利亚难民危机引发的民主倒退），民主制度的侵蚀都会导致移民外流，这是对非自由主义政权变革的市场化反应。
AI.research_question: 政治体制差异如何影响国际移民模式？民主倒退是否以及如何导致移民外流？
AI.motivation: 理解民主制度侵蚀对人口流动的影响，超越传统经济解释，揭示非自由主义治理作为系统性移民推动因素的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较政治学框架、制度理论、民主倒退理论、移民推拉理论
AI.method: 双重差分（DiD）估计方法，利用以色列和欧洲的民主倒退作为准外生冲击进行自然实验
AI.findings: 在以色列和欧洲两个背景下，民主倒退都显著增加了移民外流；移民是对非自由主义政权变革的市场化反应，表现为对国有化产业、限制言论自由和破坏法治政策的敏感性。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了移民理论，将非自由主义治理确立为超越经济因素的系统性移民推动因素；揭示了民主制度侵蚀与人口流动之间的因果关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于民主倒退社会后果的实证证据；有助于理解人口流动的政治驱动因素，为移民政策制定提供参考。

title: The Financial Consequences of Being Denied Benefit Access
affiliations: Cornell University, Cornell University,  and University of California, San Diego (UCSD)

detail.title: The Financial Consequences of Being Denied Benefit Access
detail.abstract:
We examine the causal impact of being denied benefit access on the financial well-being of marginally-excluded households. Using experimental and quasi-random variation in the flexibility of mandatory intake interviews and a unique linkage between administrative Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) and credit report data, we find that households screened out of SNAP due to administrative barriers suffer tangible downstream economic consequences. Specifically, we find that process-related denials increase debt and delinquencies, and decrease credit scores. These results highlight the economic importance of implementation design and its role in strengthening (or undermining) the financial protection provided by social insurance programs.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，因行政障碍被排除在SNAP福利计划外的家庭面临显著的经济后果，包括债务增加、信用评分下降和违约率上升。
AI.research_question: 被拒绝获得福利对边际排除家庭的财务福祉有何因果影响？
AI.motivation: 探讨行政障碍如何影响社会保险计划提供的财务保护效果
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会保险计划实施设计理论，行政障碍对家庭财务影响理论
AI.method: 使用实验和准随机变异方法，结合SNAP行政数据和信用报告数据的独特链接
AI.findings: 因行政障碍被排除在SNAP外的家庭债务增加、违约率上升、信用评分下降
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了行政实施设计在经济结果中的重要性，拓展了社会政策评估的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者优化福利申请流程提供实证依据，强调简化行政程序对保护家庭财务的重要性

title: Monetary Policy without an Anchor
affiliations: Stanford University - Department of Economics, University of Pennsylvania, European Central Bank (ECB) and University of Wisconsin-Madison

detail.title: Monetary Policy without an Anchor
detail.abstract:
Policymakers often cite the risk that inflation expectations might “de-anchor” as a key reason for responding forcefully to inflationary shocks. We develop a model to analyze this trade-off and to quantify the benefits of stable long-run inflation expectations. In our framework, households and firms are imperfectly informed about the central bank’s objective and learn from its policy choices. Recognizing this interaction, the central bank raises interest rates more aggressively after adverse supply shocks and accepts short-run output costs to secure more stable inflation expectations. The strength of this reputation channel depends on how sensitive long-run inflation expectations are to surprises in interest rates. Using high-frequency identification, we estimate these elasticities for emerging and advanced economies and find large negative values for Brazil. We fit our model to these findings and use it to quantify how reputation building motives affect monetary policy decisions, and the role of central bank's credibility in promoting macroeconomic stability.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个模型来分析通胀预期脱锚风险，发现央行为了稳定长期通胀预期会采取更激进的加息政策，特别是在新兴经济体如巴西中，这种声誉渠道效应显著。
AI.research_question: 央行如何通过政策选择来稳定长期通胀预期，以及声誉渠道在货币政策决策中的作用？
AI.motivation: 政策制定者经常担心通胀预期可能"脱锚"，这是应对通胀冲击时采取强力措施的关键原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不完全信息框架下，家庭和企业对央行目标存在信息不对称，通过观察政策选择进行学习。
AI.method: 开发理论模型分析声誉渠道，使用高频识别方法估计新兴和发达经济体的弹性系数，并将模型拟合到实证发现中。
AI.findings: 央行在面对不利供给冲击时会更激进加息，接受短期产出成本以稳定通胀预期；巴西等新兴经济体的长期通胀预期对利率意外的敏感性很高。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了央行声誉渠道的理论框架，量化了稳定长期通胀预期的收益。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行政策制定提供了量化工具，强调了央行信誉在促进宏观经济稳定中的重要作用。

title: ESG PERFORMANCE AND FINANCIAL OUTCOMES IN TAIWAN: EVIDENCE FROM TAIWAN’S ESG ADOPTION TO COVID-19
affiliations: National Taiwan University, National Taiwan University, National Taiwan University and National Taiwan University

detail.title: ESG PERFORMANCE AND FINANCIAL OUTCOMES IN TAIWAN: EVIDENCE FROM TAIWAN’S ESG ADOPTION TO COVID-19
detail.abstract: This study examines the relationship between environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance and firm financial outcomes in Taiwan, where policy‑mandated ESG adoption is still emerging. Using ESG pillar scores and TESG tier classifications, the analysis refines existing evidence in several ways. First, Environmental (E) and Social (S) scores are negatively associated with return on assets (ROA) in cross‑sectional models, but these effects attenuate in within‑firm estimators, suggesting that ESG–profitability linkages largely reflect time‑invariant firm characteristics rather than short‑term operational changes. This pattern aligns with findings from other emerging markets, where early ESG adoption is cost‑intensive, though modest within‑firm penalties appear when extreme values are trimmed. Second, pooled OLS results show a positive association between Social scores and return on equity (ROE), indicating that equity markets may reward stakeholder‑oriented practices more readily than accounting‑based measures. TESG tier analysis further reveals that ESG leaders (TESG_A) outperform laggards on ROE but underperform on ROA, highlighting a duality in which ESG leadership enhances market valuation even as short‑term profitability lags. Extending the analysis to the COVID‑19 pandemic, results show that environmental practices mitigated asset return erosion, while intensified social engagement modestly improved outcomes, though governance effects remained weak. Overall, the findings underscore that ESG’s financial implications depend heavily on context and time horizon, with implications for managers balancing operational costs, investor expectations, and sustainable value creation.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨台湾企业ESG表现与财务绩效的关系，发现在新兴市场背景下，环境和社会得分与资产回报率呈负相关，但社会得分与股本回报率呈正相关，表明ESG的财务影响因衡量指标和情境而异。
AI.research_question: 在台湾这个ESG政策强制采用仍处于新兴阶段的市场中，ESG表现与企业财务绩效之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 理解在ESG政策强制采用仍处于新兴阶段的市场中，ESG表现如何影响企业财务绩效，为管理者和投资者提供决策参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于ESG（环境、社会和治理）理论框架，分析ESG各维度对企业财务绩效的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用ESG支柱得分和TESG层级分类，采用横截面模型和公司内部估计量进行分析，并扩展至COVID-19疫情期间的影响。
AI.findings: 1）环境和社会得分与ROA负相关，但主要反映时间不变的公司特征；2）社会得分与ROE正相关；3）ESG领导者在ROE上表现更好但在ROA上表现较差；4）疫情期间环境实践缓解了资产回报率下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对新兴市场ESG-盈利能力关系的理解，揭示了ESG财务影响的复杂性和情境依赖性。

title: Epistemic Justice and Institutional Responsibility in Academia: Toward a Comprehensive Framework for Epistemic Justice in Higher Education

detail.title: Epistemic Justice and Institutional Responsibility in Academia: Toward a Comprehensive Framework for Epistemic Justice in Higher Education
detail.abstract:
This dissertation examines epistemic justice as a fiduciary and ethical responsibility of universities, framing higher education institutions as stewards of an epistemic commons. I argue that universities bear positive duties to institutionalise epistemic openness and actively counter epistemic injustice. Drawing on Fricker’s theory of epistemic injustice, Anderson’s systemic account of epistemic justice, fiduciary ethics, and educational philosophy (Freire, Mill, Rawls), I develop a normative framework that integrates Western and Chinese philosophical perspectives, including Confucian reciprocity, Zhuangzian perspectivism, and Taoist epistemic humility.

Through comparative statutory analysis, I assess the United Kingdom’s Higher Education (Freedom of Speech) Act 2023 alongside constitutional protections in Germany, statutory ambiguity in France, and statutory minimalism in the Netherlands. These contrasts show how legislative frameworks shape institutional practices, highlighting the limitations of purely legal protections. Empirical case studies—including participatory methodologies (Boni & Velasco), microfascist institutional dynamics (Kuyumcu & Méndez-Grueso), and controversies in Groningen and Grenoble—illustrate persistent exclusionary practices and demonstrate the necessity of internal fiduciary governance.

I propose concrete institutional mechanisms to embed epistemic openness: epistemic audits, oversight roles such as Epistemic Ombudspersons, inclusive pedagogical approaches, and transparent accountability frameworks. These measures provide universities with normative clarity and practical strategies for cultivating an epistemic culture that is open, inclusive, and resilient. By embedding epistemic justice in governance, universities can fulfil their fiduciary responsibilities, strengthen legitimacy, and sustain their role as genuine custodians of knowledge.

AI.tldr: 该论文将大学定位为知识公地的管理者，提出大学有积极责任制度化学术开放性并主动对抗知识不公。通过比较英国、德国、法国和荷兰的立法框架，结合实证案例研究，作者构建了一个整合中西哲学视角的规范性框架，并提出具体的制度机制来嵌入知识开放性。

title: From Academic Research to Academic Games: How Modern Science Lost its Way
affiliations: Shenyang Normal University

detail.title: From Academic Research to Academic Games: How Modern Science Lost its Way
detail.abstract: This article documents the transformation of scientific publishing from a pursuit of knowledge to a sophisticated gaming system. Examining three critical institutional mechanisms-the evolution of journal functions, the introduction of impact factor metrics, and the implementation of peer review systems-we demonstrate how modern academic publishing has fundamentally inverted scientific incentives. Where Newton's era prioritized genuine discovery, contemporary academic systems reward publication volume, citation manipulation, and conformity to mainstream paradigms. The introduction of SCI impact factors converted quality assessment from evidence-based judgment to quantifiable metrics, creating incentives for garbage proliferation rather than genuine research. Peer review systems, intended to ensure quality, have instead created infrastructure for paradigm protection and the suppression of paradigm-challenging research. The result: modern science has evolved from an intellectually rigorous enterprise requiring substantial effort with uncertain outcomes into a reliable game where mediocre work receives predictable rewards. This transformation explains contemporary phenomena including widespread error proliferation, systematic suppression of corrections, corruption of review article functions, and exponential growth in fraudulent research. We argue that recovery requires recognizing this gaming structure and fundamentally restructuring incentive systems to restore alignment between scientific advancement and career reward mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了科学出版从追求知识转变为游戏化系统的过程，分析了期刊功能演变、影响因子指标引入和同行评审系统三大机制如何导致学术激励机制的异化，使现代科学从严谨的知识追求变成了可预测奖励的游戏。

AI.theoretical_framework: 制度变迁理论、激励机制理论、科学社会学理论
AI.method: 历史制度分析，通过考察科学出版三大关键机制（期刊功能、影响因子、同行评审）的演变过程来分析制度变迁。
AI.findings: 1）期刊功能从知识传播转变为职业晋升工具；2）影响因子将质量评估从证据判断转变为量化指标，激励垃圾论文生产；3）同行评审成为范式保护机制，压制挑战性研究；4）科学从不确定的严谨探索转变为可预测奖励的游戏。

detail.abstract: This article examines the rapid growth of Real-World Asset (RWA) tokenisation in Asia, focusing on Hong Kong as an emerging regional hub. It analyses three sectoral case studies in renewable energy, real estate, and financial instruments to illustrate the practical applications, market implications, and regulatory challenges of RWA projects. As of September 2025, the global RWA market reached an estimated value of $30.91 billion and is projected to grow into a trillion-dollar market within the next decade. The article highlights Asia's proactive regulatory initiatives aimed at developing clear tokenisation standards and promoting the sustainable and responsible growth of the virtual asset sector. Supported by regulatory sandboxes and institutional participation in leading financial centres such as Hong Kong and Singapore, the region has become a focal point of innovation in asset tokenisation. Following the introduction, Section 2 reviews the latest developments in RWA as a fast-emerging area of financial and legal practice. Section 3 presents three case studies, while Section 4 provides practical guidance for asset owners and investors. Section 5 discusses key regulatory models and the overseas expansion of Chinese enterprises through digital assets tokenisation, and Section 6 concludes with implications for regulators, investors, and policymakers.

detail.title: The Canons of Patent Claim Interpretation

publicationDetails.journalName: Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Justice Scalia identified three sets of canons governing the interpretation of legal texts. As for the third set of canons, those "specifically applicable to language in the various types of private documents," Justice Scalia dispensed with considering them, in part because "they have been well covered elsewhere." In this regard, he referenced various restatements of the law and treatises, each related to contracts, insurance policies, or wills. He did not, however, cite anything related to patents-certainly no restatement or treatise or other compendium analogous to those listed for contracts, insurance policies, and wills. Here I endeavor to fill that gap, to create that compendium that captures all the principles governing the interpretation of patent claims. In short, here I collect, organize, and analyze canons courts have identified as specific to the interpretation of patents. While patent claim interpretation shares certain fundamental principles with the interpretation of other legal documents, including statutes, contracts, and deeds, the canons of patent claim interpretation bear witness to the fact that there are many unique aspects of patent claim interpretation.

detail.title: The Impact of Drought on Agricultural Production in Spain

publicationDetails.journalName: Banco de Espana Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Rationale Climate change could exacerbate the magnitude and frequency of extreme weather events, increasingly affecting crop yields. This article analyses the effects of drought on the production of a selection of key crops for Spanish agriculture. Takeaways • Granular climate data and province-level data on agricultural land and production are used for the period 2000-23 to estimate the relationship between drought and the yields of a selection of crops in Spain. • The results obtained show that the adverse impact of water scarcity on crop yields differs across crops. Specifically, the impact was found to be greater on wheat, barley and olives (largely rainfed crops) than on oranges and maize (predominantly irrigated crops). • In 2022 and 2023, Spain experienced prolonged periods of water scarcity. This is estimated to have reduced wheat and barley yields by between 20% and 30%, on average, and olive yields by at least 10%.

title: Machine Learning-Driven Optimization of Automatic Service Restoration and Protection Switching in MPLS Networks
affiliations: LADOKE AKINTOLA UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY OGBOMOSO, NIGERIA, Independent, Independent and Independent

detail.title: Machine Learning-Driven Optimization of Automatic Service Restoration and Protection Switching in MPLS Networks
detail.abstract: Multi-Protocol Label Switching (MPLS) networks rely on stringent, sub-50ms service restoration mechanisms, primarily Fast Reroute (FRR) protection switching, to maintain high availability and meet Quality of Service (QoS) guarantees. While effective in achieving restoration speed, traditional FRR often sacrifices network efficiency by necessitating static, dedicated, and often 1:1 bandwidth pre-provisioning for protection paths. This paper proposes a novel framework utilizing Machine Learning (ML) to overcome this limitation, integrating Supervised Learning (SL) for proactive failure prediction with Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) for dynamic, optimal path selection. The SL component, leveraging algorithms like Support Vector Regression (SVR), anticipates network failures, converting a reactive switching problem into a time-buffered planning opportunity. The DRL agent, formulated using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), dynamically selects the most efficient protection path from a pre-calculated set based on instantaneous traffic loads and congestion metrics, thereby optimizing resource utilization while adhering to high-speed recovery requirements. Simulated results, utilizing synthetic network and traffic data, demonstrate that the DRL-optimized policy significantly reduces the mean Service Restoration Time (MRT) compared to traditional FRR baseline methods, while concurrently achieving up to a reduction in required protection capacity overhead. This methodology validates the feasibility of deploying complex DRL policies for critical, low-latency network control functions, paving the way for truly adaptive network resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合监督学习和深度强化学习的机器学习框架，用于优化MPLS网络的快速重路由保护机制，在保证50ms内服务恢复的同时显著减少保护带宽开销。

AI.theoretical_framework: 结合监督学习的故障预测和深度强化学习的动态路径选择理论框架。
AI.method: 使用支持向量回归进行主动故障预测，采用近端策略优化算法进行动态最优路径选择。
AI.findings: DRL优化策略相比传统FRR基线方法显著降低了平均服务恢复时间，同时减少了所需的保护容量开销。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了复杂DRL策略在关键低延迟网络控制功能中部署的可行性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为真正自适应的网络弹性铺平了道路，实现了资源利用优化与高速恢复要求的平衡。

detail.abstract: This bibliometric review examines three decades of business and trade research within the ASEAN region, focusing on productivity, collaboration, and emerging trends across member countries. Established in 1967, ASEAN has evolved into a significant economic entity with growing influence in global trade. Using Scopus data from 1994 to 2024, the study employs Biblioshiny and VOSviewer to map key authors, institutions, and research themes. Results reveal a significant rise in publication output, led by Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, and Thailand, reflecting heightened academic engagement. Dominant themes include "international trade," "commerce," and "competition," with recent emphasis on "sustainability," "digital transformation," and "blockchain." Strong international coauthorship highlights ASEAN's integration into the global research community. The study identifies leading institutions, assesses ASEAN's trade-related policies, and explores their broader economic implications. Limitations include reliance on a single database and the dynamic nature of the field. Future research should integrate multiple databases and examine interdisciplinary and technological intersections shaping ASEAN trade studies.

title: Hierarchy Aware Probabilistic Forecasting : Methodology and Application to Private Debt Market
affiliations: , Humboldt University of Berlin, University of Kaiserslautern - Department of Mathematics, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Hierarchy Aware Probabilistic Forecasting : Methodology and Application to Private Debt Market
detail.abstract: Hierarchical time series forecasting is an area of increasing importance in research. It is crucial for a wide range of real-world applications yet remains challenging due to the necessity of producing coherent forecasts across multiple levels of aggregation. Recent deep learning frameworks incorporate end-to-end probabilistic reconciliation to ensure hierarchical coherence, achieving state-of-the-art performance on benchmark datasets and outperforming standard post-hoc reconciliation methods. However, the application of these frameworks to financial time series, a domain characterized by low signalto-noise ratios and intricate seasonal dynamics, remains largely unexplored. Moreover, the reproducibility of their reported advantages over traditional models in the presence of more complex data has yet to be established. This study provides a thorough empirical evaluation of the latest hierarchical deep learning architectures. We apply these models to a novel dataset of loan originations and bad debts, spanning both geographical and sectoral hierarchies and enriched with exogenous macroeconomic variables. Our experiments reveal that end-to-end hierarchical frameworks decisively outperform traditional reconciliation methods, achieving up to a 35% improvement in scaled CRPS, particularly at the most granular levels where volatility is highest. Furthermore, our analysis highlights that the choice of model architecture and reconciliation strategy is critical to performance. Regularization-based coherence approaches underperform on our data, while direct reconciliation schemes show consistent and substantial gains. In our context characterized by low samples counts, we also find that the inherent data augmentation from univariate modeling leads to a decreased performance when using architectures explicitely modeling multivariate dependencies. These findings underscore the importance of tailored model design in advancing hierarchical forecasting for complex financial applications.
