detail.title: Financial Markets in Adverse Legal Environment: A Case of Islamic Banking in Tanzania

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Authors briefly state non-existence of any personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This study is self-funded

detail.abstract: The performance of financial markets largely depends on a legal environment that fosters stability, certainty, and regulatory clarity. Islamic banking, as a key player in financial markets in Tanzania is a Shariah-compliant entity in addition to observing laws of the land. On the part of the laws of the land however, Islamic banking is regulated by the legal framework primarily designed for conventional banking, offering inadequate accommodation to Shariah-compliant practices. This arrangement implies that, Islamic banking in Tanzania operates in an adverse legal environment. This fact awakened academic-curiosity of the Authors of this study to analyze the banking legal framework with a view of identifying legal challenges impacting Islamic banking operations. In so doing, the study employed documentary review and interview to gather relevant information. The information gathered, was interpreted qualitatively enhanced by a combination of a black-letter and socio-legal analysis. Findings of the study confirm that, Islamic banking in Tanzania operates in an adverse legal environment due to the existence of legal challenges that include: inadequate accommodation of Shariah-compliant practices in the banking legal framework; restrictive eligibility criteria for acquiring a banking license; constraints on asset based financing and liquidity management; the lack of central Shariah Advisory Board; and double taxation on Islamic financial transactions. The study recommends for amendments of the existing laws to accommodate Shariah-compliant practices. The amendments are essential to creating conducive legal environment that supports Islamic banking and strengthens financial markets in Tanzania.

title: Direct Democracy in Hungary (1989-2016): from Popular Sovereignty to Popular Illusion
affiliations: Eötvös Loránd University - ELTE Law School

detail.title: Direct Democracy in Hungary (1989-2016): from Popular Sovereignty to Popular Illusion
detail.abstract: Since 1989, there have been organized seven national referenda related to thirteen questions in Hungary. Based on the content of the questions raised, one can draw a line of evolution in the history of the institution: the symbolic political issues of the transition and democracy-building were followed by the country's main strategic aims. Later, national referenda functioned as instruments of outsourced daily political debate between government and opposition, while at present-based on practice-national referendum can be considered as a typical instrument of plebiscitarian direct democracy. Moreover, during this period, sixteen questions were set on the National Assembly's agenda based on successful popular initiatives. Since 2010, the legislative and the executive power's approach to direct democracy has radically transformed. The Government started to use frequently the so-called national consultation in important legislative issues-a misleading communication tool which has no legal background. Besides, based on the new Fundamental Law of Hungary (2011) and the new Act on Electoral Procedure (2013), the possibility of a successful national referendum has been greatly restricted: there is prescribed as a necessary condition for a valid result that the majority of the voters should cast a valid vote. This condition was barely reached twice in the preceding period. Furthermore, the institution of popular initiative is not part of the legal system anymore. These trends are demonstrating that the classic tools of direct democracy are losing their relevance, while populist instruments are used more frequently in practice. The purpose of this paper is to contribute to the contemporary debate related to this challenge .

title: Beyond Economic Allegiance

detail.title: Beyond Economic Allegiance

declarations.funderStatement: This article was supported by grants from the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada and the Canadian branch of the IFA.

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Toronto Law Journal (2025), volume 75, issue 4, pp. 425-65

detail.abstract: This article argues that the principle of economic allegiance, long regarded as the normative foundation of international tax jurisdiction, has become insufficient in the face of recent global reforms that expand the concept of nexus and fragment taxing authority. Nexus once served as a constraint, delimiting the states entitled to tax. Yet, as recent reforms broaden the scope of both source and residence, nexus increasingly admits multiple overlapping claims, transforming tax jurisdiction into a form of shared authority. The challenge today is no longer merely whether a state has jurisdiction but how to allocate jurisdictional fragments among states. The economic allegiance principle excludes states with no claim but offers no guidance for allocation. This article contends that fairness—particularly inter-nation equity—must be reaffirmed as the central normative principle in this allocation step. It demonstrates how recent reforms fail to articulate coherent distributional standards and instead rely on arbitrary formulas and ordering rules that disproportionately benefit wealthier states. To avoid reproducing inequities, political compromises in international tax must begin from explicit distributional considerations before turning to technical design.

publicationDetails.detailsText: What's new in Human Rights Doctoral Research. A Collection of critical literature reviews, Vol. VI, pp 13 - 54, 2023, Padova University Press

detail.abstract: The incidence of cyberviolence against women has emerged as a growing global issue, representing a novel form of violence against women. The urgency to combat such violence is amplified by internet intermediaries becoming facilitators of such harmful acts. Consequently, there is a call for redefining norms to ensure that internet intermediaries fulfil their human rights obligations by taking proactive measures to safeguard against and deter the propagation of cyberviolence against women on their platforms. The article provides a remark on the concept of cyberviolence against women, the role of digital platforms in intensifying such violence, and the debate about the human rights obligations of internet intermediaries to tackle all forms of violence occurring on their platforms. Although there are still many questions and challenges regarding procedural and definitional, legitimacy, and abuse concerns, a shift of research focus on the role and duties of Internet intermediaries as subjects of international human rights law is essential to safeguard human rights online in today's data-driven society.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Thalia González and Alyssa Faith Scott, Betwixt and Between: Restorative Justice, DEI, and Education Carcerality, 52 Fordham Urb. L.J. 1165 (2025)

detail.abstract: American K-12 public education is at a critical anti-civil rights inflection point amidst a rapidly changing landscape of federal and state education law and policy. From local anti-literacy measures to state “three strikes" exclusionary school discipline legislation to punitive federal executive orders, new legal mechanisms are conjoining to produce public school climates marked by structural violence, and the erasure of students with multiple marginalized identities. Attending to these political and legal realities is a growing cluster of legal scholarship empirically categorizing, and theoretically challenging, the rise of such anti-education civil rights obstructions. Though diverse in scope, analyses prominently center the direct effects of individual and structural mechanisms to police, punish, and exclude students from classrooms and schools. This focus has created an unattended space in the literature for interrogations centering broader collateral consequences of an expanding educational retrenchment movement. It is in this liminal gap in which this Article intervenes. Specifically, it extends prior work querying the future of school-based restorative justice under early forms of anti-woke legislation and “parental right” activism and examines new state and federal attacks on American public education that may limit the ability to advance, and in many instances, maintain restorative justice practices, policies, and programs in K-12 schools.

detail.title: The Measurement of Employee Turnover Intentions in Telecom Industry of Bangladesh

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Business Management and Economics 07: 06 June (2019)

detail.abstract: Telecom industry is a booming industry in Bangladesh. This industry has seen a tremendous growth in mobile penetration that has exceeded all expectations with over 154 million subscribers as of August 2018 versus only 4 million in 2004. To ensure sustainable growth of this large industry, the organizations have to recruit and retain their intellectual resources. In this age of highly volatile business environment, telecom companies of Bangladesh are continuously exposed by the job changing attitude of their valued employees. The employees are prone to switch their jobs to make their career advancements rather than focusing on the fundamental development of their organizations. They leave organizations for numerous reasons ranging from financial to personal ambition and in some case supervisor"s behavior, organizational culture and the working environment. Hence, this paper aims at identifying the significant factors that influence employee turnover in telecom industry of Bangladesh. The purpose of the study is to identify the factors that lead to employee turnover in these organizations. To conduct this research, 206 telecom employees at different levels were selected from three largest telecom companies of Bangladesh and interviewed. The sampled companies are: Grameen Phone Ltd, Robi Axiata Ltd, Banglalink Digital Communications Ltd. A structured questionnaire was used to collect primary information which was scored according to the liker-scale. Both descriptive and inferential statistics were used in analyzing data collected from survey. Multivariate analysis technique like factor analysis was performed to identify the factors of the turnover intention of the telecom employees in Bangladesh. Multiple regressions were run to identify the relationships between the factors identified and the overall turnover intention of the employees in this sector. The results show that there are seven factors concerning the turnover intension of the telecom sector industry of Bangladesh. The factors are: dishonesty and conflict with the supervisor, fulfillment of personal demand and promotion, supervisor change induces job switch, unfair performance influence turnover, alternative employee affects turnover, geographic location affects turnover decision, and fringe benefits help staying in the company.

detail.title: Women in a Micro-Enterprise Development Program in Bangladesh
detail.abstract: MIDAS introduced MIDI as a special credit program under its assistance and service package in July 1993 to offer short-term loans to small entrepreneurs on easy terms and conditions. The main purpose of this initiative was to create employment opportunities and promote entrepreneurs in Bangladesh by providing adequate financial managerial and technical support and assistance to the enterprises. MIDAS places great emphasis on the development of women entrepreneurs in Bangladesh and about 20 percent of all commercial and development activities of MIDAS are devoted to the development of women-owned or women-managed enterprises. Furthermore it is required to address problems faced by women entrepreneurs. The main objective of this study was to evaluate the MIDI programs of MIDAS and to assess their contribution in generating employment opportunities for the unemployed including women. Data was collected between 1993 and 1995: primary data was collected through a survey of 15 micro-enterprises 2 supported by MIDI in Dhaka and Khulna. For collecting primary data a diverse sample was identified that included different types of MIDI-supported micro-enterprises. Interviews were conducted with their entrepreneurs using a structured questionnaire. Secondary data was collected from the MIDAS head office at Dhaka and from its Khulna divisional office.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了MIDAS的MIDI小额信贷项目在1993-1995年间对孟加拉国小企业就业创造的贡献，特别关注女性企业家发展。
AI.research_question: MIDAS的MIDI项目对创造就业机会（包括女性就业）的贡献如何？
AI.motivation: MIDAS于1993年推出MIDI小额信贷项目，旨在为小企业家提供短期贷款，创造就业机会并促进企业家发展，特别关注女性企业家发展（占其商业和发展活动的20%）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 小额信贷与就业创造理论，女性创业发展理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究：1993-1995年间对达卡和库尔纳的15家MIDI支持的小企业进行问卷调查，同时从MIDAS总部和分部收集二手数据
AI.findings: 基于15家小企业的调查数据，评估了MIDI项目在就业创造方面的具体效果
AI.theory_contributions: 为小额信贷项目对就业创造的影响提供了实证证据，特别关注女性创业发展的理论意义
AI.practical_contributions: 为MIDAS改进MIDI项目提供建议，帮助更好地支持小企业发展和女性创业，促进就业创造

title: Public Health Insurance and Firm Leverage
affiliations: School of Business and Management, Shanghai International Studies University, Shanghai International Studies University, Shanghai International Studies University and School of Economics, Huazhong University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Public Health Insurance and Firm Leverage
detail.abstract: We investigate the impact of public health insurance on firm leverage. To establish causality, we exploit a policy-induced exogenous shock in the implementation of Chinese national public health insurance program starting in 2007, which is Urban Resident Basic Medical Insurance (URBMI). Using a difference-in-differences approach, we find that Chinese listed firms in pilot cities implementing the URBMI program maintain higher leverage ratios than those in non-pilot cities. Employee lock-in and risk tolerance are the plausible mechanisms through which public health insurance affects corporate leverage. This study sheds light on the effects of public health insurance on firm financing decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究公共医疗保险对企业杠杆率的影响，利用中国2007年城镇居民基本医疗保险实施的政策冲击，发现试点城市上市公司比非试点城市企业维持更高杠杆率，员工锁定效应和风险承受能力是主要机制。
AI.research_question: 公共医疗保险如何影响企业杠杆率？
AI.motivation: 探讨公共医疗保险政策对企业融资决策的影响机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于员工锁定效应理论和风险承受能力理论
AI.method: 双重差分法，利用中国城镇居民基本医疗保险实施的政策外生冲击
AI.findings: 试点城市上市公司比非试点城市企业维持更高杠杆率
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了公共医疗保险通过员工锁定和风险承受能力影响企业融资决策的理论机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解公共医疗保险对企业行为的影响提供实证依据

title: Vavilov and Generative AI
affiliations: Thompson Rivers University - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Vavilov and Generative AI
detail.abstract: This article considers whether a decision made by generative artificial intelligence can satisfy the standard of reasonableness set out in Canada (Minister of Citizenship and Immigration) v. Vavilov. Vavilov requires that administrative decisions be justified through reasons that are transparent and intelligible to the affected party. Earlier scholarship, law, and policy have assumed that AI cannot do this because it cannot provide reasons and its inner workings are opaque or uninterpretable. However, new capabilities of large language models challenge this view. Recent experiments show that when prompted with party submissions and relevant legal materials, generative AI can produce persuasive, legally grounded reasons for decisions. The article evaluates two responses: one argues that AI decisions remain unreasonable under Vavilov since their true basis lies in opaque technical processes; the other contends that Vavilov focuses on the cogency of stated reasons, not how they were generated. The article supports the latter position, suggesting that Vavilov leaves open the possibility that AI-generated decisions can be reasonable, provided their reasons meet the decision-making standard applied to human actors.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨生成式人工智能的决策是否能满足加拿大Vavilov案确立的合理性标准。Vavilov要求行政决定必须通过透明且可理解的理据来证明其正当性。传统观点认为AI无法做到这一点，但大型语言模型的新能力挑战了这一观点。文章支持的观点是：只要AI生成的理据符合人类决策者的标准，Vavilov就为AI决策的合理性留下了可能性。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能的决策是否能满足Vavilov案确立的合理性标准？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为AI无法提供透明可理解的决策理据，但大型语言模型的新能力挑战了这一假设，需要重新审视AI在行政决策中的适用性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于加拿大最高法院Vavilov案确立的行政决策合理性标准，该标准要求决策必须通过透明、可理解的理据来证明其正当性。
AI.method: 理论分析和法律论证，结合对大型语言模型新能力的实证观察，评估AI决策与Vavilov标准的兼容性。
AI.findings: 当被提示当事人陈述和相关法律材料时，生成式AI能够产生有说服力、基于法律的决策理据。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统关于AI无法满足行政决策合理性标准的观点，为AI在行政决策中的理论地位提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为行政机构使用AI决策提供了法律理论支持，只要AI生成的理据符合人类决策标准，就可能满足Vavilov的合理性要求。

title: The Hybrid Phillips Curve and Inflation in Post-Soviet Central Asia and the South Caucasus
affiliations: Istanbul Aydin University

detail.title: The Hybrid Phillips Curve and Inflation in Post-Soviet Central Asia and the South Caucasus
detail.abstract: using quarterly data from 1996 to 2023, and continuously-updating GMM. We estimate closed-and open-economy specifications with perfect and imperfect pass-through. Inflation combines substantial backward-looking inertia with a meaningful forward-looking component: persistence is strongest in Tajikistan and Turkmenistan, while Georgia and Armenia are the most forward-oriented, and Kazakhstan is balanced. In panel estimates the backward-and forward-looking weights are about 0.55 and 0.45. Cost slopes indicate that domestic real marginal costs dominate, but imported pressures are material, accounting for about 46% of cost slopes under perfect pass-through and 41% under imperfect pass-through, with external channels especially salient in Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan. Structural parameters imply price resets roughly every two to two and a half quarters and a high yet incomplete exchange-rate pass-through near 0.87.

AI.tldr: 使用1996-2023年季度数据和连续更新的GMM方法，估计了完全和不完全传递的封闭与开放经济模型。研究发现通胀具有显著的后顾性惯性和前瞻性成分，塔吉克斯坦和土库曼斯坦通胀持续性最强，格鲁吉亚和亚美尼亚最前瞻导向，哈萨克斯坦较为平衡。面板估计显示后顾性和前瞻性权重分别约为0.55和0.45。成本斜率表明国内实际边际成本占主导，但进口压力也很重要，在完全传递下占成本斜率的46%，不完全传递下占41%，外部渠道在吉尔吉斯斯坦和塔吉克斯坦尤为显著。结构参数显示价格重置周期约为2-2.5个季度，汇率传递程度较高但不完全，约为0.87。
AI.research_question: 中亚国家通胀动态的特征是什么？特别是后顾性与前瞻性通胀预期、国内与进口成本压力以及汇率传递机制在这些国家中的作用如何？
AI.motivation: 理解中亚转型经济体的通胀动态特征，这些国家在从计划经济向市场经济转型过程中面临独特的通胀挑战，需要分析其通胀形成机制中的惯性特征、成本驱动因素和外部冲击传导机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于新凯恩斯主义菲利普斯曲线框架，结合开放经济条件下的通胀动态模型，包括完全和不完全汇率传递假设，以及后顾性和前瞻性通胀预期的混合模型。
AI.method: 使用1996-2023年季度数据，采用连续更新的广义矩估计(GMM)方法，估计封闭和开放经济模型规格，包括完全和不完全汇率传递情况。
AI.findings: 1) 通胀具有显著的后顾性惯性(权重约0.55)和前瞻性成分(权重约0.45)；2) 各国差异明显：塔吉克斯坦和土库曼斯坦持续性最强，格鲁吉亚和亚美尼亚最前瞻导向；3) 国内实际边际成本占主导但进口压力重要(占成本斜率41-46%)；4) 价格重置周期2-2.5季度；5) 汇率传递程度高但不完全(约0.87)。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了新凯恩斯主义菲利普斯曲线在中亚转型经济体的应用，揭示了这些国家独特的通胀动态特征，特别是后顾性惯性与前瞻性预期的混合特征，以及外部冲击传导机制的特殊性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中亚国家央行制定通胀目标政策提供实证依据，帮助政策制定者理解通胀惯性特征、外部冲击传导机制和汇率传递程度，从而更有效地实施货币政策。

reference: Economia Internazionale/International Economics, Volume 78, Issue 4 – November 2025, pp. 487-618.
title: Spatial Location of Firms and Industries: An Overview of Theory and Practice V2.0
affiliations: University of Geneva Dušan Sidjanski Centre of Excellence in European Studies

detail.title: Spatial Location of Firms and Industries: An Overview of Theory and Practice V2.0

publicationDetails.detailsText: Economia Internazionale/International Economics, Volume 78, Issue 4 – November 2025, pp. 487-618.

detail.abstract: Where economic activity will locate and stay in the future is one of the most important and challenging questions in economics. Even though advances in technology have reduced the cost of transport and communication, which has curtailed the 'distance penalty' for business operations, local proximity of firms that produce similar, competing and/or related products still matters, especially at times with proliferating economic sanctions and trade wars. This reinforces the absolute, rather than relative, advantages of many small areas. The location of firms depends not only on costs of production and marketing, but also on economies of scale, activity-specific backward and forward linkages (indivisible production), accumulated knowledge, path dependence, innovation, the existence of sophisticated customers (markets) and on unpredictable chance events and historical accidents. 'Global' competitiveness often depends on highly concentrated 'local' knowledge; capabilities and common tacit codes of behaviour which can be found in spatially concentrated firms (clusters). Widespread global value chains are ageing and are being redressed because of uncertainties related to supply routes, 'near-shoring' and economic sanctions. Although there are certain principles and lessons learned for the location of firms and economic policy, the issue is still complex, evolving and subject to further theoretical and empirical analysis.

AI.tldr: 尽管技术进步降低了运输和通信成本，但企业在地理上的集聚仍然重要，特别是在经济制裁和贸易战加剧的背景下。企业区位选择受多种因素影响，包括成本、规模经济、产业关联、知识积累、路径依赖等。全球价值链正在重构，企业区位问题仍然复杂且需要进一步研究。
AI.research_question: 未来经济活动将在何处定位和持续？企业区位选择的关键决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 技术进步降低了距离对企业运营的惩罚，但企业地理集聚仍然重要，特别是在经济制裁和贸易战加剧的背景下。需要理解企业区位选择的复杂决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区位理论、集聚经济理论、路径依赖理论、全球价值链理论
AI.method: 理论分析和文献综述
AI.findings: 1. 企业区位不仅取决于生产和营销成本，还受规模经济、产业关联、知识积累、路径依赖、创新、市场需求和偶然事件影响；2. 全球竞争力往往依赖于高度集中的地方知识和能力；3. 全球价值链正在因供应链不确定性、近岸外包和经济制裁而重构
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 强调绝对优势而非相对优势的重要性；2. 整合了多种区位决定因素的理论框架；3. 更新了全球化背景下企业区位理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业和政策制定者提供区位决策参考；2. 帮助企业理解在全球价值链重构背景下的战略选择；3. 为区域经济发展政策提供理论依据

title: Consultation Brief on the CUSMA 2026 Review: A submission to Global Affairs Canada
affiliations: New York Law School

detail.title: Consultation Brief on the CUSMA 2026 Review: A submission to Global Affairs Canada
detail.abstract: This consultation brief, submitted to Global Affairs Canada in October 2025 for Canada's 2026 review of the Canada–United States–Mexico Agreement (CUSMA), argues that Canada must approach the review as a constitutional moment for its trade and digital sovereignty. CUSMA’s “sunset clause,” described by Jared Kushner as a sixteen-year lease, institutionalizes volatility rather than stability, enabling U.S. leverage over its partners every review cycle. Drawing on the author's recent testimony before the House of Commons Standing Committee on International Trade and the author's submissions to the U.S. Trade Representative, this paper contends that Canada’s structural disadvantage lies not in negotiation skill but in the absence of institutional intelligence. It calls for the restoration of Sectoral Advisory Groups on International Trade (SAGITs 2.0) within a legislated Canadian Trade and Economic Security Council (CTESC), supported by two coordinating roles—a Trade Tsar and an Innovation Tsar—to ensure a whole-of-government approach. The brief also identifies a growing digital sovereignty deficit, as CUSMA’s digital trade provisions constrain Canada’s ability to govern algorithms, data, and cloud infrastructure. Re-anchoring North American cooperation in law, not leverage, requires Canada to legislate its right to audit algorithmic systems, localize critical data, and regulate its digital infrastructure. Foresight, not reaction, must again become Canada’s comparative advantage.

AI.tldr: 加拿大应将CUSMA审查视为贸易和数字主权的宪法时刻，通过建立制度性智能（SAGITs 2.0和CTESC）和加强数字主权（算法审计、数据本地化、数字基础设施监管）来应对美国的结构性优势。
AI.research_question: 加拿大如何在CUSMA审查中应对结构性劣势并保护数字主权？
AI.motivation: CUSMA的"日落条款"制度化了不稳定性，使美国能够在每个审查周期对其伙伴施加压力，加拿大面临制度性智能缺失和数字主权赤字的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法时刻理论、制度性智能概念、数字主权理论
AI.method: 基于作者在众议院国际贸易常设委员会的证词和向美国贸易代表提交的材料进行政策分析
AI.findings: 加拿大的结构性劣势源于制度性智能缺失而非谈判技巧，CUSMA数字贸易条款限制了加拿大对算法、数据和云基础设施的治理能力
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"宪法时刻"作为贸易协定审查的分析框架，发展了制度性智能和数字主权的理论概念
AI.practical_contributions: 建议恢复SAGITs 2.0、建立CTESC、设立贸易和创新协调官，并立法保障算法审计权、数据本地化和数字基础设施监管

title: Limits of Contingent Convertible Bonds: Evidence from the Credit Suisse Collapse
affiliations: University of Michigan Law School, University of Michigan Law School, JD Candidate Author and University of Michigan Law School

detail.title: Limits of Contingent Convertible Bonds: Evidence from the Credit Suisse Collapse
detail.abstract: In the aftermath of the Global Financial Crisis, regulators encouraged banks to issue contingent convertible bonds ("CoCos") to improve the issuing bank's stability. Banks around the world have issued more than $1 trillion worth of CoCos to date. Yet it is unclear whether CoCos have achieved their intended goal of improving stability. Leveraging the unexpected banking panic in March 2023, we show that issuing banks fared worse-as measured by abnormal equity returns and probabilities of default. We also examine market dynamics after 2023 and find that the largest banks have continued to issue CoCos with similar contractual terms, though issuer characteristics are changing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，尽管监管机构鼓励银行发行或有可转换债券（CoCos）以增强银行稳定性，但在2023年3月的银行恐慌中，发行CoCos的银行表现更差。
AI.research_question: CoCos是否实现了其改善银行稳定性的预期目标？
AI.motivation: 全球金融危机后，监管机构鼓励银行发行CoCos以增强稳定性，全球银行已发行超过1万亿美元的CoCos，但其实际效果尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行稳定性和或有资本工具理论，分析CoCos在危机中的实际表现。
AI.method: 利用2023年3月意外银行恐慌作为自然实验，分析发行银行的异常股票回报率和违约概率。
AI.findings: 发行CoCos的银行在恐慌中表现更差，异常股票回报率和违约概率均显示负面结果。2023年后大型银行继续发行类似条款的CoCos，但发行人特征在变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了CoCos能自动增强银行稳定性的理论假设，揭示了或有资本工具在真实危机中的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和银行提供了关于CoCos实际效果的实证证据，建议重新评估此类工具的监管政策。

publicationDetails.detailsText: WINPEC Working Paper Series No. E2523 November 2025

detail.abstract: This study examines how gender-specific labor market opportunities affect child welfare, focusing on fatal child maltreatment. Using Japan's comprehensive vital statistics and a shift-share identification strategy exploiting differential regional exposure to national industry employment shocks (2005-2018), we find striking opposite effects by gender. A 0.5% point increase in male employment growth increases child abuse deaths by 116%, while the same increase in female employment growth reduces these deaths by 93%. We identify maternal mental health as a key mechanism, with male employment growth correlating with deteriorating maternal well-being, while female employment opportunities improve women's psychological health. Effects are most pronounced among the vulnerable with lower socioeconomic status-precisely those most susceptible to economic shocks. Our findings reveal that aggregate employment policies can mask offsetting gender-specific effects with profound consequences for child welfare. The results suggest that targeted interventions enhancing women's economic opportunities could simultaneously reduce child maltreatment and advance gender equality. More broadly, this research demonstrates the critical importance of gender-disaggregated analysis in economic policy design, as standard employment measures may conceal significant distributional effects on family welfare.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过日本2005-2018年数据发现，男性就业增长0.5个百分点会使儿童虐待死亡增加116%，而同等女性就业增长则减少93%的儿童虐待死亡。母体心理健康是关键机制，男性就业恶化母亲心理健康，女性就业机会改善女性心理健康。
AI.research_question: 性别特定的劳动力市场机会如何影响儿童福利，特别是致命儿童虐待？
AI.motivation: 理解就业政策对儿童福利的性别差异化影响，揭示标准就业指标可能掩盖的家庭福利分配效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场机会与家庭福利关系的理论框架，关注性别差异化的经济冲击传导机制。
AI.method: 使用日本全面生命统计数据，采用shift-share识别策略，利用不同地区对国家行业就业冲击的差异暴露度。
AI.findings: 男性就业增长显著增加儿童虐待死亡，女性就业增长显著减少儿童虐待死亡；母体心理健康是核心机制；弱势社会经济群体受影响最大。

AI.practical_contributions: 表明增强女性经济机会的政策可同时减少儿童虐待和促进性别平等；为针对性干预提供实证依据。

title: Optimizing Mobility and Fairness in Public Housing Allocation
affiliations: University of British Columbia, Sauder School of Business, Students, Desautels Faculty of Management, McGill University, University of British Columbia (UBC) - Sauder School of Business, UBC Sauder School of Business and Independent

detail.title: Optimizing Mobility and Fairness in Public Housing Allocation
detail.abstract: We study a centralized public housing allocation problem, where a housing authority, faced with both move-in and transfer requests, is tasked with the assignment of available housing units to applicants. Motivated by operational challenges at a Canadian provincial housing authority (hereafter, the Housing Authority), we propose a dynamic allocation framework whose objective function incorporates both mobility and fairness. We model the unmet requests from one housing type i to type j as a queue indexed by (i, j, and adapt the dynamic matching queue framework developed by Gurvich and Ward (2014) (G&W 2014) to analyzing this problem, where each matching corresponds to a circulation over the directed graph. We propose a periodic review policy, in which the optimal housing allocation is derived from solving a min-cost circulation problem with convex costs. We prove that by selecting the appropriate review cycle, the periodic review policy is asymptotically optimal as arrival rates grow large, converging to an imbalance-based lower bound at an improved rate compared to G&W (2014). In a case study, we use real data to simulate the public housing waitlist system, evaluate the trade-off between fairness and mobility, and demonstrate near optimality of our policy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究公共住房分配问题，提出结合公平性和流动性的动态分配框架，使用最小成本循环算法，证明周期性审查策略的渐近最优性，并通过案例研究验证政策效果。
AI.research_question: 如何在公共住房分配中平衡公平性和流动性需求？
AI.motivation: 加拿大省级住房管理局面临的操作挑战，需要同时处理新入住和转移请求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Gurvich和Ward(2014)的动态匹配队列框架，将未满足的住房类型间请求建模为队列。
AI.method: 周期性审查策略，通过求解凸成本的最小成本循环问题来确定最优住房分配。
AI.findings: 周期性审查策略在到达率增长时渐近最优，收敛速度优于G&W(2014)框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 改进了动态匹配队列框架的收敛速度，提出了基于不平衡的下界收敛分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共住房分配提供了可行的动态分配框架，在真实数据模拟中表现出接近最优的性能。

title: Smart Contracting in Network Markets
affiliations: Stanford University - Graduate School of Business and University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School

detail.title: Smart Contracting in Network Markets
detail.abstract: For bilateral bargaining in network markets, we show that holdup is eliminated when contracts are atomically settled with smart contracts. Applications include over-the-counter trading networks, purchases requiring third-party financing, and other multi-agent markets in which pairs of agents bargain bilaterally over terms that could potentially affect their outside-option values in negotiations with other firms. Under this protocol, the terms of a contract proposed to any firm can be given a “green light” by that firm, which automatically converts those terms into a binding contract if and only if the terms proposed to all other firms are also assigned green lights and thus likewise converted to contracts. We analyze tree-based networks, including hub-spoke and chain networks. Under mild technical conditions, the unique outcome of any Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium is immediate agreement on socially efficient contracts that generate equal gains for every firm.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究网络市场中双边议价问题，提出通过智能合约实现原子结算可以消除套牢问题。在树状网络结构下，完美贝叶斯均衡的唯一结果是立即达成社会效率最优的合同，使所有企业获得均等收益。
AI.research_question: 在网络市场中，如何通过智能合约和原子结算机制消除双边议价中的套牢问题？
AI.motivation: 传统网络市场中的双边议价存在套牢问题，即一方可能因担心对方在后续谈判中改变立场而推迟达成协议，导致效率损失。

AI.findings: 在温和技术条件下，任何完美贝叶斯均衡的唯一结果是立即达成社会效率最优的合同，所有企业获得均等收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了通过智能合约实现原子结算来消除套牢问题的理论框架，扩展了网络议价理论。

publicationDetails.detailsText: International Journal of Intercultural Relations, volume 103, 2024[10.1016/j.ijintrel.2024.102075]

detail.abstract: Vaccines save lives, but vaccine hesitancy remains a global health challenge. That makes it critical to explore the factors that influence whether people get vaccinated. Perceived risk is a pivotal factor in traditional health behavior theories, such as the Risk Perception Attitude framework and the Health Belief Model. However, studies have found that these models are less predictive of COVID-19 vaccination in some cultures. Studies that test culture by comparing nations are useful, but nations have different healthcare systems and policies that are hard to equate and control for. We addressed this question by testing regional cultural differences in China. Drawing on the rice theory, we compared residents from China's historical rice-farming areas (which are more interdependent) with those from wheat-farming areas (which are more independent). We surveyed 1,872 participants in 29 provinces and found that the models of perceived risk predicted COVID-19 mainly in historically wheat-farming areas. Conversely, in historically rice-farming areas, vaccination behavior was not significantly linked to perceived risk. These findings suggest that cultural factors, rooted in historical farming practices, influence vaccination behaviors. By comparing regions within the same country, we can rule out confounds of national policy and healthcare systems. These insights could help policymakers understand how to tailor vaccination campaigns to people from different cultures.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，在中国不同农业文化区域中，感知风险对新冠疫苗接种行为的影响存在差异。在历史小麦种植区（独立性文化），传统健康行为理论中的感知风险能预测疫苗接种；而在历史水稻种植区（互依性文化），感知风险与疫苗接种行为无显著关联。
AI.research_question: 文化因素如何影响感知风险与新冠疫苗接种行为之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 疫苗犹豫是全球健康挑战，传统健康行为理论在某些文化中对COVID-19疫苗接种的预测力不足，需要探索文化因素的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险感知态度框架、健康信念模型、水稻理论（水稻种植区培养互依性文化，小麦种植区培养独立性文化）
AI.method: 在中国29个省份对1,872名参与者进行调查，比较历史水稻种植区和小麦种植区的文化差异
AI.findings: 感知风险模型主要在历史小麦种植区能预测COVID-19疫苗接种行为，而在历史水稻种植区，疫苗接种行为与感知风险无显著关联
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了文化因素（根植于历史农业实践）对健康行为理论适用性的调节作用，深化了对文化如何影响健康决策的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了文化敏感的健康干预策略，建议针对不同文化背景的人群定制疫苗接种宣传活动

title: United States v. Slaughter: Constitutional Care and the Duty of Maintenance
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: United States v. Slaughter: Constitutional Care and the Duty of Maintenance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research was conducted independently through a Praxis Foundry, without institutional affiliation, funding, or influence from any government, corporation, or political organization. The author has no financial or personal relationships that could be perceived to shape the analysis.

detail.abstract: United States v. Slaughter (25-332) extends the Constitutional Physiology framework into its third stage-Care-arguing that cause-based removal and due-process safeguards act as therapeutic mechanisms within the constitutional body. Where Cook diagnosed reflex misfire and Wilcox restored homeostasis, Slaughter articulates the duty of maintenance: the President's obligation under the Take Care Clause to tend, not dominate, the machinery of law. Drawing on empirical data from CRS, GAO, and Brookings, the brief shows that unchecked removal produces measurable inflammation-leadership churn, regulatory volatility, and collapsing public trust-while for-cause standards and minimal procedure yield stability and legitimacy. It reads precedent (Myers, Humphrey's Executor, Morrison, Collins) as adaptive immune memory: a jurisprudence that learns precision through experience. Within this physiological model, judicial affirmation operates as therapy-channeling executive energy back into stewardship and constitutional balance. This SSRN Research Edition preserves full amicus formatting for replication and pedagogical use. It is disseminated by Praxis Foundry001, an independent civic-research initiative in Michigan, as a public-domain artifact for empirical and doctrinal study.

AI.tldr: 本文通过宪法生理学框架分析美国诉斯劳特案，认为基于原因的免职和正当程序保障是宪法体系中的治疗机制，总统有义务维护而非主导法律机制。
AI.research_question: 基于原因的免职和正当程序保障如何作为宪法体系中的治疗机制运作？
AI.motivation: 探讨总统免职权对宪法平衡的影响，以及如何通过制度设计维护行政稳定性和公众信任。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪法生理学框架，将宪法体系视为有机体，免职程序作为治疗机制。
AI.method: 基于CRS、GAO和布鲁金斯学会的实证数据，分析免职实践对领导层变动、监管稳定性和公众信任的影响。
AI.findings: 不受约束的免职导致领导层频繁变动、监管波动和公众信任崩溃，而基于原因的标准和最低程序带来稳定性和合法性。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了宪法生理学框架到第三阶段（关怀），将司法先例解读为适应性免疫记忆。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据，支持基于原因的免职标准和正当程序保障，以维护宪法平衡和行政稳定性。

title: Destructive Leadership and Dysfunctional Behavior in Health Systems

detail.title: Destructive Leadership and Dysfunctional Behavior in Health Systems
detail.abstract: This case study investigates destructive leadership and dysfunctional organizational behaviors within a New Zealand disability support service operating under a District Health Board (DHB). The analysis explores how poor leadership practices, including autocratic management, nepotism, and lack of communication, create a disruptive and passive-aggressive workplace culture that undermines service quality and staff well-being. Drawing on established leadership theories-including the contingency model, Vroom-Yetton decision-making framework, and the emerging concept of leadingship-the paper contrasts vertical, control-oriented leadership with horizontal, participatory approaches. It highlights how constructive leadership behaviors, followership engagement, and distributed decision-making can improve morale, accountability, and collaboration. The study proposes a new conceptual organizational model emphasizing leadingship, continuous professional learning, and integrated mentoring to rebuild trust and performance. The findings underscore that leadership reform in public health services requires both structural redesign and behavioral transformation to foster sustainability, equity, and community engagement.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨新西兰残疾支持服务中的破坏性领导力与功能失调组织行为，分析专制管理、裙带关系和沟通缺失等不良领导实践如何破坏服务质量和员工福祉，并提出强调领导力、持续学习和指导的新组织模型。

title: More Than a Resource: The Illegal Sand Trade and its Risk to the Global South
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: More Than a Resource: The Illegal Sand Trade and its Risk to the Global South
detail.abstract: Sand is one of the most plentiful resources in the world, making its growing scarcity paradoxical. Despite its abundance, most sand is unsuitable for its desired purpose: industrialization. The limited supply of ideal sand has prompted a surge in illegal extractions, which has developed into a black market impacting global societies. In spite of its far-reaching circumstances, research into the implications of a sand market has been underexplored. This paper examines the illegal sand trade and the multidimensional risk it poses in five domains (social, political, economic, environmental, geopolitical) in the Global South, the region with the most sand insecurity. To evaluate the complex threats sand poses on various nations, I’ve developed a robust framework introducing a novel Sand Risk Index (SRI) quantifying the severity of sand-related risks on a scale of 1 to 10. Utilizing three case studies from vastly different areas of the Global South–India, Kenya, and United Arab Emirates (UAE)–this study compares how institutional factors shape a nation’s susceptibility to the deleterious impacts of the sand trade. The study reveals that India faces the highest overall risk due to the presence of sand mafias and governmental corruption, followed by Kenya for its localized cartel activity. While the UAE is largely insulated from the illegal sand trade, it remains geopolitically dependent on the resource, leaving the nation vulnerable. Ultimately, the perplexing nature of sand highlights how institutional dependency drives instability in the Global South.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了全球南方的非法沙子贸易及其在五个领域（社会、政治、经济、环境、地缘政治）带来的多维风险，开发了沙风险指数（SRI）来量化风险严重程度，并通过印度、肯尼亚和阿联酋的案例研究比较了制度因素如何影响国家对沙子贸易负面影响的脆弱性。
AI.research_question: 制度因素如何塑造全球南方国家对非法沙子贸易负面影响的脆弱性？
AI.motivation: 尽管沙子是世界上最丰富的资源之一，但适合工业化的理想沙子供应有限，导致非法开采激增并形成影响全球社会的黑市。然而，关于沙子市场影响的研究仍然不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度依赖理论、多维风险框架（社会、政治、经济、环境、地缘政治）
AI.method: 开发沙风险指数（SRI）量化风险严重程度（1-10分），并使用三个案例研究（印度、肯尼亚、阿联酋）进行比较分析
AI.findings: 印度面临最高的总体风险（存在沙子黑手党和政府腐败），其次是肯尼亚（地方卡特尔活动），阿联酋虽然基本不受非法沙子贸易影响，但在地缘政治上依赖该资源而保持脆弱
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了沙风险指数（SRI）作为量化沙子相关风险的新框架，深化了对制度依赖如何驱动全球南方不稳定性的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估和管理沙子贸易风险的工具，揭示了不同制度背景下沙子贸易的差异化影响

title: Microbial Biocontrol Agents in Integrated Pest Management: Current Applications and Future Prospects
affiliations: ACTAG

detail.title: Microbial Biocontrol Agents in Integrated Pest Management: Current Applications and Future Prospects
detail.abstract: Microbial biocontrol agents represent environmentally compatible alternatives to synthetic pesticides in integrated pest management programs. This review examines the current applications of bacteria, fungi, viruses, and nematodes as biological control agents against insect pests. We analyze mechanisms of action, field efficacy, and commercial development of major entomopathogens including Bacillus thuringiensis, Beauveria bassiana, Metarhizium species, baculoviruses, and entomopathogenic nematodes. Recent advances in formulation technology, mass production, and application methods have enhanced reliability and adoption rates. However, challenges persist including variable field performance, production costs, limited shelf life, and scalability issues across diverse agricultural sectors. Integration of microbial agents within comprehensive IPM frameworks offers promising pathways toward sustainable agriculture, with particular attention to socioeconomic implications for smallholder farmers. Future research priorities include developing multi-strain consortia, enhancing environmental persistence, optimizing application timing, and leveraging genomic tools for strain improvement. Climate change considerations and emerging technologies including nanotechnology and precision agriculture present both challenges and opportunities for advancing microbial biocontrol effectiveness in the decades ahead.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了微生物生物防治剂作为合成农药的环保替代品在害虫综合治理中的应用，分析了细菌、真菌、病毒和线虫等主要昆虫病原体的作用机制、田间效果和商业化发展，探讨了当前面临的挑战和未来研究方向。

title: Legislative Integrity and Accountability Act (LIAA): A Constitutional Antibody Against Financial Conflicts in Congress
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Legislative Integrity and Accountability Act (LIAA): A Constitutional Antibody Against Financial Conflicts in Congress

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Prepared by Praxis Integrity Foundry (Study Buddy3 instance) with SB-Consortium support (SB1 research engine; SB2 narrative distiller). All errors are ours. We thank allied clinics and watchdogs for prior public-interest work. This draft follows the Emotions-into-Action Framework (EAF) protocols for evidence separation and antifragility.

detail.abstract: Public confidence in Congress erodes when lawmakers and senior staff trade assets that intersect with their official duties. The Legislative Integrity and Accountability Act (LIAA) operationalizes a narrow, evidence-based response: a ban on trading individual stocks, options, derivatives, futures, and cryptocurrencies by members, spouses, and senior staff, coupled with divestiture into qualified ultra-blind trusts, seven-day machine-readable disclosures for permitted assets, and annual GAO audits. Grounded in integrity as a civic immune reflex, the Act's design follows a detect→respond→encode sequence: (1) detect conflicts through standardized disclosure architecture and auditable triggers; (2) respond with enforceable prohibitions and scaled penalties, including forfeiture and automatic referrals; (3) encode memory via public portals, audit cadence, and a replicable model statute for state harmonization. The paper situates LIAA within comparative ethics regimes and articulates constitutionally sound justifications for targeted restrictions to prevent corruption and its appearance. We provide an Evidence Patch and a Citations-to-Chase (CTC) ledger to transparently separate verified findings from open items. LIAA is drafted for high replicability (≤15% tailoring) and evaluated using the Integrity Review Rubric. The proposed mechanism adds one constitutional "antibody": the ability to neutralize conflicted trading while preserving dignity through least-restrictive means.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出《立法诚信与问责法案》(LIAA)，通过禁止国会议员及高级幕僚交易个股及相关金融产品，建立可审计的披露机制和处罚体系，以解决利益冲突问题。

title: How Venture Capital Shifts Focus During Crises: Non-Standard Errors in Conti et al. (2019)
affiliations: , Heriot-Watt University and Heriot-Watt University - Edinburgh Business School

detail.title: How Venture Capital Shifts Focus During Crises: Non-Standard Errors in Conti et al. (2019)
detail.abstract: This paper reanalyses data from Conti et al.(2019), which studies how venture capital (VC) investment strategies shift during financial crises. Using the original dataset, we re-estimate the main relationships with other model specifications. For example, we replace linear probability models with logit regressions and incorporate startup stage as an explicit covariate, instead of splitting the sample. We apply the non-standard errors methodology developed in Menkveld et al. (2024) to assess robustness of findings across a wide set of plausible model specifications. The reanalysis confirms that crises reduce overall VC investment but, in contrast to previously reported, also reveals greater heterogeneity across investor experience and their focus on specific stages. Specifically, experienced VCs maintain performance through sector specialisation in early-stage deals, while inexperienced investors benefit from diversification and syndication. The results underscore that multiple viable investment strategies can coexist under financial stress and highlight how methodological transparency enhances our understanding of VC decision-making during crises.

AI.tldr: 本文重新分析Conti等人(2019)的数据，研究风险投资策略在金融危机期间的变化。通过使用非标准误差方法评估多种模型设定的稳健性，发现危机减少了总体VC投资，但揭示了投资者经验和投资阶段策略的异质性：经验丰富的VC通过早期阶段行业专业化维持绩效，而缺乏经验的投资者从多元化和联合投资中获益。

AI.motivation: 重新分析Conti等人(2019)的研究数据，使用更严谨的方法论评估原有发现的稳健性，并揭示先前研究中可能被忽视的异质性效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险投资决策理论、金融危机对投资行为的影响、投资者经验与绩效关系、投资组合理论
AI.method: 重新估计Conti等人(2019)的原始数据，使用logit回归替代线性概率模型，引入创业阶段作为显性协变量，应用Menkveld等人(2024)的非标准误差方法评估多种模型设定的稳健性
AI.findings: 1) 危机减少了总体VC投资；2) 投资者经验和投资阶段策略存在显著异质性；3) 经验丰富的VC通过早期阶段行业专业化维持绩效；4) 缺乏经验的投资者从多元化和联合投资中获益
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了金融危机期间多种可行投资策略并存的现象，挑战了单一最优策略的传统观点，强调了投资者经验在危机应对中的调节作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为VC投资者在危机期间提供策略选择指导：经验丰富者可专注早期阶段行业专业化，缺乏经验者可通过多元化和联合投资降低风险，增强方法论透明度有助于更好理解VC危机决策

title: Dharma as Dharana: A Civilisational Anchor for Economic Prosperity
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management (IIM), Kozhikode

detail.title: Dharma as Dharana: A Civilisational Anchor for Economic Prosperity
detail.abstract: The dominant paradigm in development economics, from Weber to modern institutionalism, has often treated non-Western cultures as either impediments to be overcome or as residual factors secondary to formal institutions. This paper challenges this view by analyzing the classical Indian concept of Dharma as a comprehensive framework for political economy. We argue that the Dharmic framework, far from being an otherworldly obstacle, represents a sophisticated and coherent pre-modern blueprint for generating endogenous prosperity. We analyze Dharma as an integrated system operating on three levels: at the individual level, it provides a behavioral technology for cultivating the non-cognitive skills essential for human capital formation; at the societal level, its ethical norms provide the cultural software for generating the social trust necessary to lower transaction costs; and at the state level, the doctrine of Rājadharma provides a virtue-centric but institutionally-buttressed solution to the problem of constraining state power, creating the preconditions for what are now termed inclusive institutions. By translating this ancient framework into the language of modern political economy, we offer a new perspective on the deep cultural foundations of institutional success and long-run development.

detail.abstract: Equilibrium Leadership reconceives leadership as a measurable system capability that sustains coherence while enabling continuous adaptation. Integrating bounded rationality, behavioral game theory, and complexity thinking, the framework models organizations as nested adaptive systems where individual choices, group norms, and leadership signals coevolve through coupled feedback on action and meaning. title: From Steel to Screens: Deindustrialization, Mass Incarceration, and the Rise of the Adult Industry in Post‑Industrial America
affiliations: Independent researcher

detail.title: From Steel to Screens: Deindustrialization, Mass Incarceration, and the Rise of the Adult Industry in Post‑Industrial America

declarations.funderStatement: No funder

detail.abstract: This paper examines the parallel rise of the U.S. adult entertainment industry and the decline of traditional manufacturing jobs in the late 20th century, placing both within the larger context of America's War on Drugs and mass incarceration. Using economic, sociological, and historical sources, it argues that changes in America's labor economy and punitive government policies created conditions for marginalized groups-especially working-class women and formerly incarcerated people-to turn to sex work and digital pornography as accessible sources of income. The relationship between deindustrialization, the carceral state, and commodified intimacy signifies a broader restructuring of American capitalism after 1970.

title: Spectral Early Warning System for Ethereum MEV Coordination Cascades

detail.title: Spectral Early Warning System for Ethereum MEV Coordination Cascades
detail.abstract: We develop a deterministic spectral framework for diagnosing coordination risk in Ethereum's Proposer-Builder Separation (PBS) and Maximum Extractable Value (MEV) decision network. Unlike consensus capture analysis that focuses on stake concentration, we measure coordination vulnerability in the strategic interaction layer between builders, relays, and proposers. The framework computes three key performance indicators (KPIs): (1) Stability Margin S measuring buffer to instability, (2) Early Warning Index (EWI) flagging cascade vulnerability, and (3) Cascade Risk Index (CRI) indicating directional risk. We derive closed-form intervention thresholds using spectral conditions from network game theory, provide formal proofs of stability conditions, identify specific edges for mitigation, and provide an operator playbook. The analysis separates PBS coordination dynamics from consensus capture (stake-based supermajority risk), computing Effective Control Power (ECP) independently. Applied to stylized Ethereum scenarios, the framework demonstrates how relay concentration and client monoculture shift KPIs predictably. Monte Carlo simulations with 10,000 runs confirm EWI = 0 as a theoretically sharp threshold in the coordination model. All KPIs are deterministic diagnostic signals computed from network structure; empirical validation of predictive power through out-of-sample forecasting tests remains critical future work.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个确定性谱框架来诊断以太坊PBS和MEV决策网络中的协调风险，通过三个关键指标衡量构建者、中继者和提议者之间的战略互动层协调脆弱性。
AI.research_question: 如何诊断以太坊PBS和MEV决策网络中的协调风险？
AI.motivation: 现有共识捕获分析主要关注权益集中度，但缺乏对构建者、中继者和提议者之间战略互动层协调脆弱性的衡量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于网络博弈论的谱条件，构建协调风险诊断框架。
AI.method: 开发确定性谱框架，计算三个关键指标：稳定性边际S、早期预警指数EWI和级联风险指数CRI，并进行蒙特卡洛模拟验证。
AI.findings: 框架能够预测中继集中度和客户端单一文化对KPIs的影响，EWI=0被确认为协调模型的尖锐阈值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了稳定性条件的正式证明，使用网络博弈论谱条件推导了封闭形式的干预阈值。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了具体的缓解边，提供了操作者手册，将PBS协调动态与共识捕获风险分离计算。

title: Policy Brief-"Unheard Voices: Strengthening Transgender Rights Implementation in  Kashmir"

detail.title: Policy Brief-"Unheard Voices: Strengthening Transgender Rights Implementation in  Kashmir"
detail.abstract: NALSA 1 followed by the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019 has been a watershed in transgender rights movement in India 2. However, despite the central legislation, a Transgender Policy, 2022 3 and 2025 and multiple schemes like SMILE, NISHTHA 4 , and a centralised transgender portal, change has not permeated in the lives of transgender persons in Kashmir 5. Through insights from my PhD fieldwork from 2024-2025, I conducted 14 indepth interviews with transgender persons. Focus of the study was to understand their lived experiences which revealed many social, economic, psychological and legal patterns in their marginalisation rather than producing large-scale statistical data. The fieldwork shows that even after a decade of NALSA and Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019, the ground implementation of the both in Kashmir remains limited to issuance of ID cards and minimal monthly allowance 6. No initiatives have been taken with respect of education, employment, housing or safety. This brief gives suggestions to take policy initiative based on real life experiences and suggestions of the transgender persons of Kashmir. II. The Disconnect: National Law vs. Local Reality (The Structural Barriers) Defining the Problem The difference between the constitutional and legislative mandate and lived realities of transgender persons can be understood through four dimensions: family, education, employment and inheritance.

title: Perceptions of Employee Motivation and its Role in Work Efficiency: A Qualitative Case Study in the Basic Court of Pristina
affiliations: AAB College and

detail.title: Perceptions of Employee Motivation and its Role in Work Efficiency: A Qualitative Case Study in the Basic Court of Pristina
detail.abstract:
Background: Kosovo's judicial system has undergone ongoing legal reforms and improvements in infrastructure. However, despite these efforts, overall performance remains a significant challenge for public institutions, highlighting the need to examine factors influencing institutional efficiency. Among these, employee motivation is particularly significant due to its direct impact on the daily operations of the judicial system. While international academic literature widely acknowledges the crucial role of employee motivation in institutional performance, this study specifically investigates how employees at the Basic Court of Prishtina perceive motivation as influencing their work efficiency. Methods: The research draws on findings from semistructured interviews with court employees and compares these perceptions with published official data on institutional efficiency. 

Results and Conclusions: The analysis reveals the absence of sustainable mechanisms for fostering employee motivation within the Basic Court of Prishtina. Continuous reforms have not yielded the expected outcomes, mainly due to the predominance of a bureaucratic culture within the institution. Findings from this study closely align with the international academic literature and Public Service Motivation (PSM) theory, which posits that motivation is not merely a matter of financial compensation but is strongly linked to recognition, inclusion, and opportunities for professional development. Findings from this research underscore the need for reforms that consider the human and cultural dimensions of public institutions, offering practical recommendations for establishing an effective, long-term motivation system within the judicial system.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了普里什蒂纳地方法院员工动机对工作效率的影响，发现该法院缺乏可持续的员工激励机制，官僚文化阻碍了改革效果，建议改革应考虑公共机构的人文和文化维度。

AI.method: 对法院员工进行半结构化访谈，并将访谈结果与已发布的官方制度效率数据进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 普里什蒂纳地方法院缺乏可持续的员工激励机制，持续的司法改革未达预期效果，主要原因是机构内官僚文化占主导地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了公共服务动机理论在科索沃司法环境中的适用性，强调了动机的多维性特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为司法系统改革提供了实践建议，强调需要考虑公共机构的人文和文化维度，建立有效的长期激励体系。

title: The Rise And Regulation Of Digital Monopolies: Revisiting Competition Law in The Age Of Big Tech
affiliations: Aligarh Muslim University (AMU), Faculty of Law, Students,  and Independent

detail.title: The Rise And Regulation Of Digital Monopolies: Revisiting Competition Law in The Age Of Big Tech
detail.abstract: The digital economy of the 21st century is dominated by a handful of Big Tech companies that function less as market participants and more as digital monopolies, controlling data, infrastructure, and user ecosystems. Traditional competition law frameworks, rooted in industrialera cartels and price-fixing, often fail to capture the realities of platform capitalism-where power flows from network effects, surveillance-based data collection, and cross-market integration rather than price manipulation alone. This paper revisits global and Indian debates on regulating Big Tech, drawing insights from the European Union's Digital Markets Act, the United States' antitrust enforcement, China's state-capitalist crackdowns, and India's evolving Competition Commission of India interventions. By integrating theoretical frameworks such as Schumpeterian innovation, the Chicago School's efficiency model, Zuboff's theory of surveillance capitalism, and Tirole's focus on contestability, the paper develops a hybrid understanding of digital market power. Using case studies-including Google's dominance in search, WhatsApp's tipping point in India, and predatory acquisitions like Facebook-Instagram-the research highlights both the risks of overregulation (stifling domestic innovation) and under-regulation (entrenching monopolistic power). The study concludes that India must craft a Digital Competition Bill that balances innovation with accountability, promoting indigenous ecosystems like ONDC while resisting dependency on foreign gatekeepers. In doing so, the paper positions India at the legal crossroads of the digital economy, where choices made today will shape not only markets but also democracy, culture, and sovereignty.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了21世纪数字经济的垄断问题，指出传统竞争法框架难以应对平台资本主义的现实。通过比较欧盟、美国、中国和印度的监管实践，结合多种理论框架，提出了平衡创新与问责的数字竞争法案建议。

AI.findings: 过度监管会抑制国内创新，而监管不足则会固化垄断力量。印度需要制定平衡创新与问责的数字竞争法案。

title: The Effect of a Lottery on Collusion Sustainability
affiliations: University of Campania Luigi Vanvitelli

detail.title: The Effect of a Lottery on Collusion Sustainability
detail.abstract: There are many evidences which prove that cartels' price leads to an economic inefficiency, due to the reduced consumers welfare. Antitrust authorities have set up different ways to defeat and prevent collusive agreements, but as widely showed by the literature, deterring collusion may have adverse effects, like higher price in surviving cartels, reduced turnover of firms' employees, and disincentive for competing firms to cooperate, in the sense that if firms exchange information about the evolution of demand or costs, then they may adopt better choices; moreover, deterring collusion may have even a pro-collusion effect. The paper suggests an additional anti-cartel tool which does not have side effects, and supporting no cost, it can get worse collusion stability. Analysing a supergame of collusion, in a Bertrand duopoly framework in which is run a two-stage lottery, we show that deviation strategy becomes more attractive, even if lottery jackpot tends to zero.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无成本、无副作用的反卡特尔工具，通过在两阶段彩票的伯特兰双寡头框架中分析合谋超级博弈，证明即使彩票头奖趋近于零，偏离策略也会变得更具吸引力，从而削弱卡特尔稳定性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种无副作用且无成本的反卡特尔工具来削弱合谋稳定性？
AI.motivation: 传统反卡特尔措施可能产生副作用，如提高剩余卡特尔的价格、减少企业员工流动率、抑制企业间有益合作，甚至可能产生促合谋效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 伯特兰双寡头竞争模型、合谋超级博弈理论、两阶段彩票机制
AI.method: 在伯特兰双寡头框架中构建合谋超级博弈模型，引入两阶段彩票机制进行分析
AI.findings: 即使彩票头奖趋近于零，偏离策略也会变得更具吸引力，从而有效削弱卡特尔稳定性
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种新颖的无成本反卡特尔机制，扩展了合谋稳定性理论

title: The Optimal Degree of Control: Mean-Field Theory Meets Adversarial Asset Pricing
affiliations: Thalesians

detail.title: The Optimal Degree of Control: Mean-Field Theory Meets Adversarial Asset Pricing
detail.abstract: We develop an equilibrium theory of the optimal degree of economic control, ranging from laissez-faire to central planning. A continuum of agents interact through prices and externalities; a regulator chooses a control intensity α ∈ [0, 1] that scales coordination instruments (tax/subsidy schedules, quotas, information frictions, infrastructure). Nature plays an adversarial role, distorting the aggregate law of motion within an ambiguity budget. We pose the problem as a coupled HJB-Fokker-Planck-Isaacs system and prove that the optimal α ⋆ equalizes the regulator's marginal coordination benefit with the marginal costs from (i) distorted incentives/innovation drag, (ii) market-priced ambiguity premia inferred from options, and (iii) administrative deadweight loss. In an LQG mean-field economy we obtain closed-form formulas for α ⋆ and comparative statics. We outline a calibration using option surfaces to pin down the ambiguity wedge.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个从自由放任到中央计划的经济控制最优程度均衡理论，通过耦合的HJB-Fokker-Planck-Isaacs系统求解最优控制强度α*，并证明其等于监管者的边际协调收益与扭曲激励/创新拖累、市场定价的模糊性溢价和行政无谓损失等边际成本相等。

AI.theoretical_framework: 均衡理论、HJB-Fokker-Planck-Isaacs系统、LQG均值场经济模型、模糊性预算理论
AI.method: 建立连续体代理人通过价格和外部性互动的模型，监管者选择控制强度α，通过耦合的HJB-Fokker-Planck-Isaacs系统求解最优控制策略
AI.findings: 最优控制强度α*等于监管者的边际协调收益与扭曲激励/创新拖累、市场定价的模糊性溢价和行政无谓损失等边际成本相等

title: HR Transformation Post COVID-19
affiliations: and Tilak Maharashtra Vidyapeeth

detail.title: HR Transformation Post COVID-19
detail.abstract: Currently, COVID-19 is spreading like wildfire and leaving behind its deadly impact across the world. IMF has already predicted the contraction of the world economy in 2020 by 3% as compared to nearly 2.3% GDP growth in 2019. Some experts are projecting one of the worst recessions the world has ever seen. This would have a varied impact on businesses depending on the sector, financial muscle, and management decisions of the company. While certain businesses may permanently close down, some will struggle and some will come out as a winner. There will be both permanent and temporary lay-offs leaving millions of people jobless. Even in this imminent recession, a certain set of companies into health-care, pharma, medical equipment, online media & entertainment, e-learning, digital payment/fintech, food processing, etc. are witnessing increased demand and will create new job opportunities for some. Human Resources are the lifeline of any organization and need to be handled with the utmost care and dignity all the time, and not just during this crisis. Companies are planning to take various short-term and long terms HR measures best suited to them in their wisdom.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了COVID-19疫情对全球经济和企业的影响，分析了不同行业面临的挑战与机遇，并重点讨论了企业应采取的人力资源管理策略。

AI.motivation: COVID-19疫情导致全球经济衰退，不同行业受到不同程度影响，企业需要制定有效的人力资源管理策略来应对危机。

AI.method: 文献综述和案例分析。
AI.findings: 疫情导致全球经济衰退，不同行业影响各异；医疗健康、在线娱乐、数字支付等行业需求增加；企业需要采取短期和长期人力资源措施。

AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了在疫情危机中的人力资源管理实践指导，帮助企业在危机中保持竞争力。

title: The Relationship between Digital Human Resource Management and Organizational Performance
affiliations: and Tilak Maharashtra Vidyapeeth

detail.title: The Relationship between Digital Human Resource Management and Organizational Performance
detail.abstract: Digital human resource management (HRM) is the process of digitally transforming HR practises and procedures to be more effective through the use of electronic media, mobile, analytics, and information technology (IT). In other words, digital HRM mainly entails handling all human resourcerelated tasks via the internet, software, and soft technologies. In order to be effective and relevant in the future, all organisations must embrace digitization or digital transformation. If not, they will fall behind other businesses in the market sector. This paper covers a number of studies and talks about the idea and many facets of digital HRM. This study primarily used secondary data. The findings are crucial for organisations since they will help them implement digital HRM successfully and boost productivity. Researchers could also benefit from the findings because they will serve as a foundation for understanding how digital HR affects organisational success.

title: What's The Matter With Lozada: How The Board Of Immigration Appeals Coerces Immigration Lawyers To Breach Legal Ethics
affiliations: Adjunct Professor

detail.title: What's The Matter With Lozada: How The Board Of Immigration Appeals Coerces Immigration Lawyers To Breach Legal Ethics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: In general, if an attorney makes a mistake, they can cure it by notifying the forum and filing the appropriate remedy. Immigration law, by contrast, stands alone by requiring the client (or a new attorney) to corroborate any mistake by filing a bar complaint against the first attorney. This requirement was established in a 1988 case, called Matter of Lozada. Much has been written on how the Lozada rule is unnecessary (a mistake does not need to be corroborated by a bar complaint and state bars are complaining about a deluge of unnecessary complaints for negligence) and harms the immigration practitioner (immigration law is difficult enough without the added possibility of having a bar complaint filed against a lawyer who had been helping a client to the best of their ability). As much as this is true, this article adds to the conversation by illustrating how the Lozada requirement is an egregious violation of legal ethics. Lozada requires an attorney to turn against their former client and reveal (and weaponize) secrets, confidences, and communications in an adversarial forum that the Board of Immigration Appeals, and government attorneys themselves, use against the non-citizen. The Lozada rule is a chimera of justice, a means not to cure attorneys' mistakes but to weaponize attorneys against their clients and separate lawyers from a population who critically need representation. Whether intended or not, these consequences of the Lozada rule are compelling reasons to abandon the bar complaint requirement to determine if a former attorney made a mistake.

AI.tldr: 本文分析移民法中的Lozada规则，该规则要求客户必须对前律师提出律师协会投诉才能证明律师失误，这违反了法律伦理，将律师武器化对抗客户，应废除该要求。
AI.research_question: Lozada规则如何违反法律伦理原则？
AI.motivation: 现有文献已指出Lozada规则不必要且伤害移民律师，但本文从法律伦理角度揭示其更深层次问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律伦理理论，包括律师-客户保密义务、忠诚义务等专业伦理原则。
AI.method: 理论分析和案例研究，基于1988年Lozada案建立的规则及其后果。
AI.findings: Lozada规则强制律师背叛前客户，泄露机密信息，在对抗性程序中被政府用来对付非公民客户。
AI.theory_contributions: 从法律伦理角度系统分析Lozada规则的伦理违规问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为废除Lozada规则提供伦理依据，保护移民客户获得有效法律代表的权利。

title: Private International Law And The Regulation Of Foreign Legal Practice: India In A Global Context
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Private International Law And The Regulation Of Foreign Legal Practice: India In A Global Context
detail.abstract:
The increasing globalization of legal services has compelled nations to reassess their regulatory frameworks governing foreign legal practitioners. India’s 2025 reforms by the Bar Council of India mark a significant step in harmonizing domestic legal protection with the facilitation of cross-border legal practice. These reforms permit foreign lawyers to advise on international law, foreign law, and participate in cross-border transactions and international arbitration, while restricting the practice of Indian domestic law to licensed practitioners. This paper examines the regulatory framework, compares India’s approach with global best practices in the United States, United Kingdom, Singapore, and Hong Kong, and evaluates the associated challenges and opportunities. By exploring mechanisms such as reciprocity requirements, fly-in/fly-out provisions, and professional ethics oversight, the study highlights India’s emerging role as a hub for international legal services. The paper concludes that these reforms, if effectively implemented, can stimulate domestic legal markets, foster international collaboration, and enhance the quality of legal practice in India.

As Professor Dicey famously remarked, “Private international law is the law which governs the relations between persons in different states; it is the law of legal order in the world of conflicting jurisdictions.” This observation underscores the importance of clear regulatory structures in an era of increasing cross-border legal interactions.

AI.tldr: 印度2025年律师协会改革允许外国律师就国际法和外国法提供咨询，参与跨境交易和国际仲裁，但限制印度国内法律执业。该研究比较了印度与美英新港的监管框架，评估了挑战与机遇，认为改革能促进印度成为国际法律服务中心。
AI.research_question: 印度2025年律师协会改革如何平衡国内法律保护与促进跨境法律执业？
AI.motivation: 法律服务的全球化迫使各国重新评估对外国法律从业者的监管框架，印度需要协调国内法律保护与促进跨境法律实践的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以戴西的国际私法理论为基础，强调在管辖权冲突的世界中明确监管结构的重要性。
AI.method: 比较分析法，将印度改革与美英新港的全球最佳实践进行对比研究。
AI.findings: 印度改革通过互惠要求、临时执业规定和职业道德监督等机制，正在成为国际法律服务枢纽。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家如何在全球法律服务市场中制定平衡的监管框架提供了理论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度法律市场国际化提供了实施路径，有助于刺激国内法律市场、促进国际合作并提升法律实践质量。

title:
시간 비의존적 인과율의 정식화: 카르마 프랙탈 인과론 (KFC 공식 도출)을 통한 인과적 필연성의 근원적 논증
(A Time-Independent Formalism of Causality: The Fundamental Argument of Causal Necessity via Karma Fractal Causality (KFC, Including Formula Derivation))
affiliations: Independent

detail.title:
시간 비의존적 인과율의 정식화: 카르마 프랙탈 인과론 (KFC 공식 도출)을 통한 인과적 필연성의 근원적 논증
(A Time-Independent Formalism of Causality: The Fundamental Argument of Causal Necessity via Karma Fractal Causality (KFC, Including Formula Derivation))
detail.abstract: This paper formalizes a time-independent mathematical framework of Karma Fractal Causality (KFC), overcoming the fundamental limitations of traditional causality rooted in time-dependency. KFC redefines the manifestation of all events not by the temporal flow (t) perceived by a finite observer, but by the 'necessity of sequential action'. KFC posits that events manifest as a logical necessity when the Causal Action Density (D K) surpasses the system's Critical Density Threshold (D CRIT). D K accumulates non-linearly, proportional to the square (2) of the Causal Mismatch Noise (N M IS) from the Optimal Causal State (ocs). The resulting Non-linear Causal Amplification Factor (CC) dictates the exponential intensity (I M) of the event. The theory unifies phenomena from the D M IN (stable atomic nucleus formation) to D M AX (black hole creation) under the single logic of D K critical breakthrough, demonstrating KFC's scale-invariant causality across micro and macro scales. Ultimately, KFC argues that all causal action in the universe is a necessary sequential action of least action towards the ultimate goal of Causal Integrity (C.I.).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个独立于时间的数学框架——因果分形理论（KFC），克服了传统因果性基于时间依赖的根本限制。KFC重新定义了所有事件的表现方式，不是通过有限观察者感知的时间流，而是通过'序列行动的必要性'。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个独立于时间的因果性数学框架，以克服传统因果性基于时间依赖的根本限制？
AI.motivation: 传统因果性理论受限于时间依赖性，无法解释某些非时间序列的因果现象，需要一个新的理论框架来统一微观和宏观尺度的因果现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因果分形理论（KFC）框架，包括因果行动密度（D K）、临界密度阈值（D CRIT）、因果失配噪声（N MIS）、最优因果状态（ocs）、非线性因果放大因子（CC）等核心概念。
AI.method: 建立时间独立的数学框架，通过因果行动密度的非线性积累和临界突破机制来解释事件的发生。
AI.findings: KFC能够统一从原子核形成（D MIN）到黑洞创建（D MAX）的各种现象，证明了该理论在微观和宏观尺度上的尺度不变性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个独立于时间的因果性理论框架，重新定义了事件发生的逻辑必要性，为理解宇宙中的因果行动提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 该理论框架可能为物理学、宇宙学等领域提供新的研究工具，帮助解释传统因果理论难以解释的现象。

title: Supermajority in Parliamentary Systems - A Concept of Substantive Legislative Supermajority: Lessons from Hungary
affiliations: Eötvös Loránd University - ELTE Law School

detail.title: Supermajority in Parliamentary Systems - A Concept of Substantive Legislative Supermajority: Lessons from Hungary

publicationDetails.detailsText: Hungarian Journal of Legal Studies, volume 58, issue 3, 2017[10.1556/2052.2017.58.3.3]

detail.abstract: This paper focuses on the theoretical grounds of supermajority, its special relevance in parliamentary systems and the related experiences from Central and Eastern Europe, especially Hungary. In parliamentary systems, the support of the parliamentary majority is a necessity and sufficient condition for governance-there is no need for supermajoritarian decision-making in issues of daily politics. A qualified majority has a different function and is an internal institutional limit of the legislative power-protecting the minority interests against the unilateral decisions of the majority in the most important issues of the political community. The Hungarian situation from 2010-2015 demonstrates that minorities cannot influence the decisions where the supermajority represents a one-party opinion. Moreover, decisions of the supermajority can block future modifications of the future parliamentary majority as well. It will be argued in this paper that only a substantive approach to supermajority can support its basic function.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了超级多数原则的理论基础，特别关注其在议会制中的特殊意义以及中欧和东欧（尤其是匈牙利）的相关经验。文章认为，在议会制中，议会多数的支持是治理的必要和充分条件，日常政治问题无需超级多数决策。合格多数具有不同功能，是立法权力的内部制度限制，旨在保护少数派利益免受多数派在政治共同体最重要问题上的单边决定影响。匈牙利2010-2015年的情况表明，当超级多数代表单一政党意见时，少数派无法影响决策。此外，超级多数的决定还可能阻碍未来议会多数对相关内容的修改。本文主张只有对超级多数采取实质性方法才能支持其基本功能。
AI.research_question: 超级多数原则在议会制中的理论基础和功能是什么？特别是在中欧和东欧（匈牙利）的实践经验如何揭示了超级多数原则的运作效果？
AI.motivation: 探讨超级多数原则在议会制民主中的理论依据和实践意义，分析其在保护少数派利益方面的实际效果，特别是在匈牙利2010-2015年期间超级多数被单一政党控制的情况下的经验教训。
AI.theoretical_framework: 议会制民主理论、超级多数原则理论、少数派保护机制、立法权力制衡理论
AI.method: 理论分析结合案例研究，重点分析匈牙利2010-2015年期间超级多数原则的实践经验和效果
AI.findings: 1. 在议会制中，超级多数不是日常政治决策的必要条件；2. 超级多数的主要功能是保护少数派利益，防止多数派在重要问题上的单边决定；3. 当超级多数被单一政党控制时，少数派保护功能失效；4. 超级多数的决定可能阻碍未来议会多数的修改能力
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了对超级多数原则的实质性理解方法，强调其作为立法权力内部制度限制的功能，而非简单的数量优势
AI.practical_contributions: 为议会制民主国家设计超级多数机制提供了实践指导，强调需要防止超级多数被单一政党垄断，以确保其保护少数派利益的基本功能得以实现

affiliations: Canadian University of Bangladesh and Bangladesh University of Professionals (BUP)

detail.title: Impact of Social Media Marketing on Buying Behaviors of Superstore Customers in Bangladesh

publicationDetails.detailsText: PYC Nepal Journal of Management, volume 14, issue 1, 2023[10.3126/pycnjm.v14i1.41054]

detail.abstract: This study aims at identifying the impact factors of social media marketing on the buying behaviors' of superstore customers in Bangladesh. Altogether, 291 buyers were surveyed from five superstores of Bangladesh such as, Agora, Meena Bazar, Shwapno, Almas Super Shop, and Nandan. A structured questionnaire with five points Likert scale was used to survey the customers. Descriptive statistics were used to present the profiles of the respondent customers while inferential statistics like Factor Analysis was used to identify the impact factors and Multiple Regression Analysis was used o identify the relationships between the impact factors and the overall impact on purchase decision of the customers. Study identified four significant impact factors such as, quick searching and verification of authenticity of product information, easy to order and saving time, customers addiction to media buying, and awareness of innovative and new products that induce the superstore customers to make their purchase decisions. This study suggests that the policymakers should focus on authenticity of product information, easy to order system that saves time, publicity of innovative and variety of products, and customer addicted towards media marketing for making the customers inclined towards buying the products and services from superstores of Bangladesh.

AI.tldr: 本研究识别了社交媒体营销对孟加拉国超市顾客购买行为的影响因素，发现产品信息真实性验证、便捷订购节省时间、顾客对媒体营销的依赖以及创新产品认知是四个关键影响因素。

detail.abstract: COVID-19 changed the world we live in. We need research to understand the challenges people are still experiencing. We used a longitudinal design to test the relationships among non-death loss, avoidance coping, and perceived COVID-19 impact before and after China's dramatic zero-COVID policy reversal. We tracked 270 emerging adults who just graduated from college at four time-points from June 2022 to December 2023. Two waves were conducted before the end of zero-COVID policy; one wave was immediately after the policy ended (Dec. 2022); and one wave was one full year later. Non-death losses were consistently associated with increased perceived COVID-19 impact at later stages. This association remained consistent even one year after the end of zero-COVID policy. People tended to use more avoidance coping immediately after the policy transition, but it did not have longitudinal associations with perceived COVID-19 impact. Our findings suggest that non-death loss has a long-lasting psychological impact of COVID-19.

detail.abstract: The intention to reuse Garuda Indonesia Airline became the leading indicator in the minimum standard of air transport services. The main problems in this research were the less attractive promotion efforts that hindered passengers from reusing Garuda Indonesia Airline and unclear web check-in procedures, which were difficult for some passengers to understand. This research aimed to know the direct and indirect influences of service quality and web check-in on the intention to reuse Garuda Indonesia Airline mediated by passenger trust at Soekarno-Hatta Airport. The research was quantitative, with the data collecting method using a questionnaire distributed online through a purposive sampling technique to 210 passengers of Garuda Indonesia Airline. The data was analyzed using the partial least squares-structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) method. This research showed five direct influences: the influence of service quality and web check-in on passenger trust, the influence of service quality, web check-in, and passenger trust on the intention to reuse Garuda Indonesia Airline. Passenger trust could mediate the influence of service quality and web check-in on the intention to reuse Garuda Indonesia Airline at Soekarno-Hatta Airport. From the results of this research, it could be concluded that service quality and web check-in through passenger trust are needed to reach the intention of reusing Garuda Indonesia Airline.

detail.abstract: Gender relations in the garment sector of Bangladesh are discriminatory. Female workers are looked down and suppressed by the managements with comparatively low wage and heavy workload. They are ill-treated and harassed by their supervisors, managers, and owners, as they are less reactive and easily manageable. Poverty has forced them to join garment work despite their families' negative attitude towards this iob. Their poor education makes them an easy victim of the situation and strips them off their legal rights. The work gives them some economic independence and empowerment but their conditions have not improved. Their meager wages force them to lead a sub-standard life. They switch over frequently to different factories for apparent short-term gains, like better pay, empowerment and good work environment. Female garment workers often encounter injuries at work. But the management is negligent about it. The demand of the management is to achieve production target at any cost. To improve the present situation, the female workers need government protection, social recognition, and company support.

detail.title: Is the Autocratic Political System Smoother and More Inclusive Than the Democratic System In El Salvador?

publicationDetails.detailsText: AL-ĪMĀN Research Journal (IRJ), Volume 02, Issue 03, October-December 2024 PP: 44-52

detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the shift from democratic to autocratic rule in El Salvador, focusing on the period before and after the presidency of Nayib Bukele. It challenges the conventional view of autocracy as inherently oppressive, arguing that Bukele's administration has brought relative peace and stability to a nation previously plagued by gang violence and economic instability under democracy. The analysis explores three pillars of Bukele's governancecentralization of power, limited freedom, and nationalism-that have contributed to reducing El Salvador's homicide rate and enhancing social order. While democratic governments in El Salvador struggled with issues like gang violence, unemployment, and poverty, the Bukele administration's authoritarian measures have led to a significant decline in crime and economic improvement. However, the paper also highlights concerns regarding human rights abuses, loss of civil liberties, and the risk of long-term political suppression. By comparing the outcomes of both political systems, the paper seeks to shed light on whether autocracy, in this case, offers a more effective governance model than democracy, especially in addressing complex social challenges.
